f_alien_weed_1.name: alien plant
f_alien_weed_1.description: An alien plant, a knee-high tightly-coiled bundle of reddish-yellow stalks with jagged leaves extending every which way.  It looks very difficult to walk through.

f_alien_weed_2.name: alien plant
f_alien_weed_2.description: An alien plant, a collection of delicate bluish-white strands with small white globes along their length.  They seem to float almost like seaweed, despite being a terrestrial plant.

f_alien_weed_3.name: alien plant
f_alien_weed_3.description: An alien plant, a single, cylindrical dark-red trunk with a small cluster of leaves on top.  It makes a hollow sound when struck.

f_active_backup_generator.name: active backup generator
f_active_backup_generator.description: A ubiquitous piece of compact machinery meant for running anything from the bathroom lights to electric stoves and other necessities when grid electricity is unavailable.  This one is currently running.  You can hear it humming slightly when you are very close.

f_portable_generator.name: portable generator
f_portable_generator.description: A small, portable generator, one that people buy for a camp.

f_diesel_generator.name: diesel generator
f_diesel_generator.description: Big and powerful generator, used for street works.

f_military_generator.name: military diesel generator
f_military_generator.description: Big and powerful generator, painted in camo.

f_12000_gasoline_generator.name: powerful gasoline generator
f_12000_gasoline_generator.description: Big and powerful, yet portable generator.

f_m224_mortar.name: M224 mortar
f_m224_mortar.description: Deployed and ready to be used 60 mm mortar.  You are lucky you don't need to scavenge actual firing tables, as they are clipped tightly to the mortar itself.  However you can use it only for indirect fire, with a substantial precision loss.

examine_action.condition_fail_msg: You have absolutely no idea how to use this mortar.

f_atm.name: ATM
f_atm.description: For your banking convenience, this Automated Teller Machine is fully capable of operating autonomously in the event of complete network failure.  You can deposit funds from cash cards and migrate all of your inflation-adjusted earnings to a single card.  This thing has seen better days; there's been a run on the bank, and this machine has the dents and cracks to prove it.

f_atm_off.name: ATM
f_atm_off.description: Designed to withdraw money from your bank account, this machine is completely dead now, both from having no more power, and having no internet connection to do any withdraws.  While you can deconstruct it, it's effectively just a big pile of metal.

f_nm_tube.name: decaying tube
f_nm_tube.description: A decomposing fleshy stalagmite extends from the ceiling to the floor.

f_nm_tube_emitter.name: glowing decaying tube
f_nm_tube_emitter.description: A decomposing fleshy stalagmite extends from the ceiling to the floor.  Countless glowing spores weft from within, coating everything nearby.

f_nm_nether_lily.name: beautiful nether lily
f_nm_nether_lily.description: A very tall, mesmerizing blood red flower.  Its beautiful, pristine form is rooted firmly on the innards of the beast.  The flesh around it is decayed, being consumed to feed its ornate, magnanimous body.  You feel an urge to sit and admire this priceless miracle of life.

effect.u_message: You admire the lily.  Isn't it beautiful?
You worship the lily, and feel truly fulfilled.
You bow to the lily, and gain immense satisfaction in having done so.
You focus on the lily and realize it truly is perfection *incarnate*.

f_nm_nether_grass.name: nether grass
f_nm_nether_grass.description: A bed of waist high segmented blue plants that remind you of grass.  As you wade past, they react to your movement and always swivel to face you.

f_nm_nether_grass_tall.name: tall nether grass
f_nm_nether_grass_tall.description: A clump of tall, segmented blue plants that remind you of grass.  As you approach, they bend towards you, hugging your body and making movement difficult.

f_nm_nether_patchwork.name: nether patchwork
f_nm_nether_patchwork.description: A peculiar plant that is hard to distinguish, resembling a tangled mess of different terrestrial flowers and weeds firmly wedged into the monstrous flesh.  It pulses rhythmically as it rearranges its form into even weirder shapes.

f_nm_nether_lichen.name: nether lichen
f_nm_nether_lichen.description: A bed of orange, flowering lichen, covering the surface of the yellow ichor.  Every now and then, a flower disappears into the liquid, but seems to reappear the moment you look away.

f_fridge.name: refrigerator
f_fridge.description: A standard household refrigerator.  If powered, it will cool its contents to extend the time before they spoil.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_minifridge.name: minifridge
f_minifridge.description: A small fridge, often used in places where full-size fridge would be too big or too much a hassle to transport, or when you only need a small amount of items chilled.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_glass_fridge.name: single glass door fridge
f_glass_fridge.description: A modern refrigerator with a thick sheet of glass for a door, used in stores to show off the goods while keeping them cool.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_glass_fridge_double.name: double glass door fridge
f_glass_fridge_double.description: A modern refrigerator with two glass doors, to fit twice as much goods for consumers.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_heavy_duty_fridge.name: heavy-duty fridge
f_heavy_duty_fridge.description: A heavy, bulky refrigerator, used in professional kitchens.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_display_fridge.name: display fridge
f_display_fridge.description: A big glass chamber, designed to display different food in multiple rows, while cooling it at the same time.  Looks gorgeous, but has nothing good to show to you.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_minifreezer.name: minifreezer
f_minifreezer.description: A small upright freezer, used to store a small amount of perishables long term.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_chest_minifreezer.name: chest minifreezer
f_chest_minifreezer.description: A small chest freezer, used to store a small amount of perishables for a long time, if you're willing to dig them out each time that is.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_freezer.name: chest freezer
f_freezer.description: A chest freezer.  Big and power efficient, this is the dream for every Cataclysm survivor.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_heavy_duty_freezer.name: heavy-duty freezer
f_heavy_duty_freezer.description: A heavy-duty upright freezer, one that is used in a professional kitchen.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_glass_freezer.name: glass door freezer
f_glass_freezer.description: A commercial upright freezer, used to show ice creams, frozen veggies, pizza, or anything else a consumer may want frozen and preserved.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_display_freezer.name: display chest freezer
f_display_freezer.description: A commercial chest freezer, used to show off ice creams, frozen veggies, pizza, or anything else a consumer may want frozen and preserved.  Conveniently tall enough for any curious child to gaze in at the sweets.  Deconstruct it if you want to connect it to the grid.

f_glassedbody_1.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_1.description: A black glass figure of a someone frozen halfway through falling backwards, and suspended on a single leg.

f_glassedbody_2.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_2.description: A black glass figure of a person covering their face with their hands.

f_glassedbody_3.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_3.description: A black glass figure of a child.  It is difficult to make out their facial features, but it seems as if they are smiling.

f_glassedbody_4.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_4.description: A black glass figure of someone kneeling in prayer.

f_glassedbody_5.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_5.description: A black glass figure of someone in a firing posture.  Their jagged fingers are frozen squeezing a trigger that isn't there.

f_glassedbody_6.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_6.description: A black glass figure of someone leaning into the space to their right, their fingers bent as if interlaced with someone else's.

f_glassedbody_7.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_7.description: A black glass figure of someone clutching at their neck.  A delicate spray of connected glass droplets emerges between their fingers.

f_glassedbody_8.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_8.description: Most of a black glass human figure.  The face and much of the head is missing, as if scooped out, and the inner surface is perfectly smooth.

f_glassedbody_9.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_9.description: A black glass figure of someone doubled over in laughter.

f_glassedbody_10.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_10.description: A black glass figure.  Their features are too jagged to make out clearly, but they remind you of someone you knew.

f_glassedbody_11.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_11.description: A black glass figure of someone in a fighting stance, their face twisted with howls of rage and anger.  They're gripping some sort of weapon that isn't there.

f_glassedbody_12.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_12.description: A black glass figure of someone crouched over as though trying to move steathily.  Both hands are braced against a surface that isn't there.

f_glassedbody_13.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_13.description: A black glass figure of someone falling forward.  When you look more closely, it's just the upper body that's falling forward, separated from the legs.

f_glassedbody_14.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_14.description: A black glass figure of a person, their face frozen in an eternal scream.

f_glassedbody_15.name: black glass figure
f_glassedbody_15.description: A black glass figure of a…person?  One arm is visibly longer than the other and the eyes are offset from a horizontal line.  They are frozen hunched over, with their longer arm trailing on the ground.

f_vitrified_bed.name: black glass bed
f_vitrified_bed.description: A black glass sculpture of a bed.  The rumpled covers are jagged, and splinter at the touch.

f_vitrified_bathtub.name: black glass bathtub
f_vitrified_bathtub.description: A tub made from black glass, with a frozen column of onyx pouring from the tap.

f_vitrified_dresser.name: black glass dresser
f_vitrified_dresser.description: A black glass cabinet with its doors slightly ajar.  Inside is a row of hangers bearing neatly folded and entirely rigid clothing.

f_vitrified_fridge.name: black glass refrigerator
f_vitrified_fridge.description: A black glass refrigerator, its door hanging open.  Inside is a seamless surface with protrusions resembling fresh fruit and plastic bottles.

f_vitrified_armchair.name: black glass armchair
f_vitrified_armchair.description: An armchair that was presumably once very plush and comfortable.  Now the overstuffed cushions are hard, cold, and slippery.

f_vitrified_chair.name: black glass chair
f_vitrified_chair.description: A simple glass chair.  The seat is very thin, and crunches ominously under any weight.

f_vitrified_desk.name: black glass desk
f_vitrified_desk.description: A glass desk.  There are a handful of shapes atop it that suggest pens, paper, and miscellaneous knickknacks that are too jagged to identify.

f_vitrified_locker.name: black glass locker
f_vitrified_locker.description: A tall glass cabinet.  Whatever was inside will stay that way; the door is seamless with the frame.

f_vitrified_oven.name: black glass oven
f_vitrified_oven.description: A glass sculpture of a gas oven.  Bristling from the burner is a crown of jagged shards in the rough shape of an uncontrolled fire.

f_vitrified_mailbox.name: black glass mailbox
f_vitrified_mailbox.description: A glass sculpture of a mailbox.  The door is open; inside is a pile of envelopes, all razor-edged.

f_vitrified_rack.name: black glass display rack
f_vitrified_rack.description: A glass sculpture of a shelving unit.  The angled shelves are covered in jagged miscellany, most of which is firmly fused in place.

f_vitrified_sink.name: black glass sink
f_vitrified_sink.description: A glass basin and tap.  The inside stops halfway down in sheet of concentric ripples, with the tiny spire of a splashing droplet at the center.

f_vitrified_toilet.name: black glass toilet
f_vitrified_toilet.description: A toilet made of black glass.  The lid, perhaps mercifully, is fused shut.

f_vitrified_cupboard.name: black glass cupboard
f_vitrified_cupboard.description: A black glass cupboard.  The doors are fused shut, but it presumably contains glasses.

f_vitrified_planter.name: black glass garden
f_vitrified_planter.description: A planter of dark glass.  Sharp, twisting glass sprouts emerge from the black soil within.

f_vitrified_flower.name: black glass flower
f_vitrified_flower.description: A delicate little thing; a wispy stem slightly bowed under the weight of translucent petals.  The tiny barbs that line it are almost impossible to see, until it crumbles in your fingers.

f_vitrified_bench.name: black glass bench
f_vitrified_bench.description: A long, low slab of black glass.  You can't tell if the fissures here and there on the surface are natural cracks, or carved names.

f_vitrified_washer.name: black glass washer
f_vitrified_washer.description: A glass washing machine.  The inside is completely filled with black sand, some of which has spilled onto the floor.

f_vitrified_dryer.name: black glass dryer
f_vitrified_dryer.description: A mechanical dryer of black glass.  The door hangs open, and inside, you can see a jumble of what might once have been clothes, now smashed to pieces.

f_vitrified_bookcase.name: black glass bookcase
f_vitrified_bookcase.description: A heavy bookshelf, laden with books fused into the shelves and each other.  You can make out titles on the spines, but the alphabet they're written in is unfamiliar.

f_vitrified_counter.name: black glass counter
f_vitrified_counter.description: A thick cube of black glass.  On the surface, fused in place, are statues of utensils and miscellany.

f_vitrified_table.name: black glass table
f_vitrified_table.description: A slab of smooth black glass on four stout legs.  In a few places, there is shallowly rounded mass, like liquid spilled on the surface.

f_vitrified_birdbath.name: black glass birdbath
f_vitrified_birdbath.description: A glass pedestal and bowl.  Inside, frozen in the midst of washing itself in the black sand, is the delicate figure of a bird.

f_vitrified_shower.name: black glass shower
f_vitrified_shower.description: From the head of this shower descend a dozen streams of thin black glass, with frozen droplets strung from them like pearls.

f_vitrified_water_heater.name: black glass water heater
f_vitrified_water_heater.description: A cylinder of thick black glass.  The top has burst apart, and rivulets of black sand run down the side.

f_vitrified_fireplace.name: black glass fireplace
f_vitrified_fireplace.description: A fireplace of pitted glass bricks.  The fire inside has been frozen in glass at the moment it began to leap beyond the grate.

f_vitrified_firering.name: ring of black stones
f_vitrified_firering.description: A circle of smooth glass pebbles.  Inside are frozen tendrils of fire, slightly translucent.  It seems colder as you approach.

f_vitrified_floor_lamp.name: black glass lantern
f_vitrified_floor_lamp.description: A tall glass pole with a translucent shade atop it.  You know it could not possibly turn on, but in the corner of your eye, you think you might see a soft glow.

f_vitrified_box.name: black glass box
f_vitrified_box.description: A box of thin black glass.  Its edges are glisteningly sharp.

f_vitrified_sofa.name: black glass sofa
f_vitrified_sofa.description: A long bench, padded with cold glass cushions.

f_vitrified_dishwasher.name: black glass dishwasher
f_vitrified_dishwasher.description: A glass dishwasher, its door hanging open.  Inside, glass plates and utensils are half buried in black sand.

f_vitrified_doll.name: incomplete plush doll
f_vitrified_doll.description: A soft plush torso, empty of features, is lying on this sofa.

f_vitrified_bookcase_talker.name: black glass bookcase
f_vitrified_bookcase_talker.description: This bookcase is missing a book.

f_alien_tendril.name: glowing tendril
f_alien_tendril.description: A willowy tendril growing from the floor, gently waving back and forth.  A faint light spills from it.

f_alien_anemone.name: wafting anemone
f_alien_anemone.description: A fleshy white protuberance growing from the floor, with a cluster of tendrils protruding from it.  It looks almost exactly like a sea anemone, even waving gently as though underwater.

f_alien_gasper.name: gasping tube
f_alien_gasper.description: A meaty green stalactite with a thickened hide like that of a starfish, extending from the floor to the ceiling.  In the center is a series of ports somewhat like mouths, from which pour bursts of a vile-smelling gas.

f_alien_zapper.name: twitching frond
f_alien_zapper.description: A spine resembling moth antennae juts from the ground, swaying gently in the air.  Every so often, a cascade of energy arcs along it and discharges into the ceiling.

f_alien_scar.name: scarred lump
f_alien_scar.description: A pile of nondescript alien flesh, twitching and belching strange gases out of injured orifices.

f_alien_pod.name: slimy pod
f_alien_pod.description: A slick, translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  It is covered in a thick mucus, obscuring whatever is floating in the gel-like substance inside.

f_alien_pod_organ.name: organ pod
f_alien_pod_organ.description: A translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside you can see the dimly outlined shape of human organs, floating in some kind of preservative goo.

f_alien_pod_resin.name: resin pod
f_alien_pod_resin.description: A translucent pod suspended on a thin stalk.  Inside is a clean, clear, resinous-looking fluid.  You could fairly easily tear it from the stalk and take it with you.

f_alien_table.name: fleshy altar
f_alien_table.description: This pulsing protuberance juts from the floor, its sides covered in scaled, oozing skin.  The surface is flat, but undulates softly.  A handful of unidentifiable appendages reach from the sides, suggesting a sort of nightmarish living Autodoc.

f_scrap_antenna.name: scrap antenna
f_scrap_antenna.description: This contraption looks like some sort of cobbled-together transmitter or receiver antenna.  It consists of a number of mismatched blinking lights, spinning servos, and dangling wires connected to a hefty metal box.

f_exodii_signpost.name: pictographic signpost
f_exodii_signpost.description: This simple scrap metal sign has a series of pictographs on it depicting what seems to be a trade interaction.  There is a crude but understandable map beneath it.  You should take a closer look.

effect.u_message: You study the signpost.  It shows a similar set of directions to the ones you already have.  You cross-reference them and don't learn anything new.

You study the signpost.  It shows simply-drawn pictograms of a pair of hands holding out an object, and another pair taking the object and offering a pouch in return.  Beneath the pictures there's a crude but understandable map with arrows pointing to what looks like some kind of castle.  You do your best to relate those to landmarks you know about, and mark the likely location on your map.

f_exodii_botrack.name: rack of robots
f_exodii_botrack.description: A wire cage containing a number of robot parts, from chassis to limbs, firmly clamped onto sturdy hanging rods.  It looks like it would be exceptionally difficult to open it and get at them without damaging them, probably by design.

f_exodii_scanner.name: spinning dish
f_exodii_scanner.description: A slowly-spinning parabolic dish engraved with an unrecognizable pattern of symbols that might, at a guess, be some sort of circuitry pattern - or maybe a religious incantation.  It is mounted on a completely mismatched electric motor that looks fairly mundane.

f_exodii_lamp.name: scavenged utility light
f_exodii_lamp.description: The bulbs emit an eerie greenish glow, and some parts of it have a curved appearance as though the metal were grown in a lab, but by and large this isn't a particularly unusual looking area light.

f_exodii_lamp_string_warped.name: warped utility light
f_exodii_lamp_string_warped.description: This bizarre lamp is only in two dimensions - it has no depth, like an impossibly thin cardboard cutout.  The bulbs emit an eerie greenish glow, and some parts of it have a curved appearance as though the metal were grown in a lab.

f_exodii_pump.name: clanking fluid pump
f_exodii_pump.description: The huge, sweating pipes and large tank reveal this clanking and tortuous piece of equipment to be some sort of fluid pump.  It is cobbled together from several apparently ill-fitting parts that have been fitted with some very strange-looking but surprisingly clever adapters.

f_exodii_printer_large.name: metalloid printer
f_exodii_printer_large.description: This huge device fairly closely resembles a 3D printer, aside from its industrial size.  Huge spools of various thin metallic wires atop it feed into what seems to be some sort of nozzle, and massive electrical cables disappear into the wall behind it.

f_exodii_printer_small.name: circuit printer
f_exodii_printer_small.description: A tall device with a lattice of pipes and nozzles.  Based on the pile of products sitting in the output hopper, it looks like it's used as a printer for complex electronic components.

f_exodii_generator_1.name: Mavrik 10-101 power core
f_exodii_generator_1.description:
There is a faded metallic plaque on the side of this cylindrical device.  The lettering is a strange combination of English and Cyrillic script.  It reads:
Mavrik 10-101
Stabиlиtи
Saфetи
A нyuclиar фyutuр ви bilив iн

f_exodii_generator_2.name: spherical generator
f_exodii_generator_2.description: This huge steel-plated sphere gives off a soft hum as it, presumably, generates power.  A heavy lead plate bolted to the front might describe what it is, but it is written in something that looks vaguely like cuneiform.

f_exodii_generator_3.name: fluidic generator
f_exodii_generator_3.description: Twisting reams of copper and steel pipes wrap around a central core that thrums softly.  Although there are no labels in any language you recognize, the cables connected to the base suggest that this is some sort of power generator.

f_exodii_generator_4.name: rusty generator
f_exodii_generator_4.description: A tall, unremarkable cylinder capped by a wide, flat saucer.  There is heavy rusting at the base.  A series of connected cables suggest that it's some sort of power generator.

f_exodii_charger.name: personal charging station
f_exodii_charger.description: The cyborg equivalent of a bed, this is a custom-shaped near-vertical booth designed to mount a heavy metal frame and connect it to a central power supply and nutrient source.

f_exodii_charger_cheap.name: simple charging station
f_exodii_charger_cheap.description: A simple, unadorned, corroded metal charging and feeding station, with hookups for two units somewhat larger than a human to stand side by side and be recharged and refueled.

f_exodii_portal_tower.name: shimmering superstructure
f_exodii_portal_tower.description: A simple metal superstructure like you might see holding up a radio tower, this one seems to give off just the faintest hint of shimmer, like heat waves.  The metal has a burnt, iridescent pattern.  There is a boxy, unimpressive-looking device at the top of the tower.

f_exodii_portal_enclosure.name: portal enclosure
f_exodii_portal_enclosure.description: A heavy metal ring attached to dozens of wires, charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

f_exodii_floor_portal_enclosure.name: metal ring
f_exodii_floor_portal_enclosure.description: A heavy metal ring sitting on the floor, surrounding a spot charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

f_string_dimension_floor_portal_enclosur.name: metal ring
f_string_dimension_floor_portal_enclosur.description: A heavy metal ring sitting on the floor, surrounding a spot charred by residue that gives off an acrid, unfamiliar smell.

f_exodii_locator_antenna.name: locator antenna
f_exodii_locator_antenna.description: A tall metal pole solidly fixed to the roof.  It does not look activated but there's a small set of holes near its base, maybe something could be plugged in one to reboot the locator.

effect.u_message: You don't have anything that could reactivate this device

You plug the rebooter in the locator.
<color_light_green>The locator reactivates.</color>

f_crystalline_flower.name: crystalline flower
f_crystalline_flower.description: A crystalline structure that resembles a plant.

f_absence.name: less than nothing
f_absence.description: There is nothing here.  Not even time or space.

f_impaled_officer.name: impaled officer
f_impaled_officer.description: A dead body encased in high-tech armor hanging in the air.  Their form seems twisted and refracted in the light of the strange glowing crystal that has seeped out of the ground and impaled their body.

f_impaled_soldier.description: A dead body encased in military armor hanging in the air.  Their form seems twisted and refracted in the light of the strange glowing crystal that has seeped out of the ground and impaled their body.
f_impaled_soldier.name: impaled mercenary

f_empty_spike.name: empty spike
f_empty_spike.description: A strange otherworldly spike that refracts light in strange ways.  The body no longer rests on it.

effect.u_message: The body is gone but it can't have gone far, you need to destroy it.

f_string_dimension_pump.name: humming fluid pump
f_string_dimension_pump.description: A large tank connected to several pumps, driven by some unseen mechanism.

f_string_dimension_pylon.name: humming column
f_string_dimension_pylon.description: A floor-to-ceiling cylinder wrapped neatly and tightly in thick copper wire.  It has no markings, but the cables connected to the base suggest that it generates or receives some kind of power.

f_string_dimension_pylon_inert.name: inert column
f_string_dimension_pylon_inert.description: A floor-to-ceiling cylinder wrapped neatly and tightly in thick copper wire.  It has no markings, but the cables connected to the base suggest that it generates or receives some kind of power.  Perhaps it once worked, but it is now still and silent.

f_vent_inert.name: metal grate
f_vent_inert.description: A metal vent on the floor.

f_string_dimension_housing.name: metal container
f_string_dimension_housing.description: An extremely dense metal box.  It has a door with a heavy latch.  A golden plate is affixed to the door, covered in letters you do not understand.  Examine it to use the lever on the door.

f_string_dimension_housing_imploded.name: imploded clump of metal
f_string_dimension_housing_imploded.description: An extremely dense ball of imploded metal.

f_tall_vent_pipe.name: tall vent pipe
f_tall_vent_pipe.description: A thick pipe for some sort of ventilation system.  It looks sturdy enough to climb.

f_string_nuclear_fuel_cell.name: lead tube
f_string_nuclear_fuel_cell.description: A massive lead tube covered in otherworldly symbols that you do not understand.

f_utility_shelf_string_warped.name: warped utility shelf
f_utility_shelf_string_warped.description: What was once a simple heavy-duty plastic and metal shelving unit has been cleaved into three pieces, now mysteriously floating in space in a stair-like pattern, disconnected entirely from each another.

f_metal_crate_o_string_warped.name: glowing metal crate
f_metal_crate_o_string_warped.description: While this box certainly resembles a large storage crate, its panels are impossibly thin planes of magenta light.

f_air_conditioner.name: cooling unit
f_air_conditioner.description: A large, blocky appliance encased in sheet metal.  This commonplace fixture is used for cooling large indoor areas.

f_air_filter.name: central air filter
f_air_filter.description: A large synthetic membrane used to filter out dust, smoke, mites, and other contaminants from air that passes through it.

f_dishwasher.name: dishwasher
f_dishwasher.description: A large, boxy machine that uses hot water and soap to efficiently clean batches of dishes.  Now that it's sat powerless for a while, a putrid scent of rot is leaking from inside.

f_dryer.name: dryer
f_dryer.description: A common household appliance used to quickly dry large batches of clothing after they have been washed.

f_home_furnace.name: furnace
f_home_furnace.description: A gas-powered forced-air central heating unit, with an internal fan to push the air through a building's ventilation system to keep it warm.

f_washer.name: washing machine
f_washer.description: An appliance used to clean laundry.  It needs to be plugged into a grid that provides it with electricity and large amounts of water to be used.

f_oven.name: oven
f_oven.description: A standard electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  You could disconnect it and plug it into a working power grid.

f_gas_oven.name: gas oven
f_gas_oven.description: A standard gas-powered oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  It can safely contain a fire, although it's not adequately ventilated.

f_gas_oven_microwave_combo.name: gas oven and microwave combo
f_gas_oven_microwave_combo.description: A standard gas-powered oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  This one has an attached microwave.  It can safely contain a fire, although it's not adequately ventilated.  You could disassemble the shelving holding them together and pull the microwave out.

f_bellows.name: blacksmith bellows
f_bellows.description: An old device for pushing air into a blacksmith's forge to strengthen the fire and maintain a high temperature.  Useless in its current state, but good for parts.

f_drophammer.name: blacksmith drop hammer
f_drophammer.description: An anvil with a large metal hammer suspended above it in a metal framework.  It would be useful for shaping softened metal plates, or you could use the anvil by itself.

f_mill_vertical.name: vertical mill
f_mill_vertical.description: A one knee vertical milling machine, commonly known as a Bridgeport.  Used to shape blocks of metal into useful parts.  You can disconnect it to install somewhere else.

f_shredder.name: document shredder
f_shredder.description: A simple electronic device mounted to a large basket.  It is designed to efficiently destroy paper documents with sensitive information.  Good for parts, as identity theft and corporate espionage probably aren't big concerns anymore.

f_server.name: server stack
f_server.description: A large rack of specialized computers for storing and transmitting information.  Powerless and largely useless for its intended purpose, the laptops mounted inside can still be used if removed.

f_melchior_unit.name: supercomputer
f_melchior_unit.description: Hanging platters assembled into an inverted cone, their positions kept stable by dense threading of copper cabling.

f_satellite.name: large satellite dish
f_satellite.description: A large, concave metal panel with simple electronics used to receive signals from satellites.  While the hundreds of expensive machines orbiting the planet will likely continue to function indefinitely, their various purposes have all been lost.

f_solar_unit.name: mounted polycrystalline solar panel
f_solar_unit.description: A set of photovoltaic power generators, which turns solar radiation into useable electricity.  While useful before the Cataclysm, they have become priceless tools, invaluable to any survivor.  This one uses less efficient polycrystalline solar panels.

f_solar_unit_v2.name: mounted monocrystalline solar panel
f_solar_unit_v2.description: A set of photovoltaic power generators, which turns solar radiation into useable electricity.  While useful before the Cataclysm, they have become priceless tools, invaluable to any survivor.  This one uses more efficient monocrystalline solar panels.

f_oxygen_concentrator.name: oxygen concentrator
f_oxygen_concentrator.description: A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  It needs power to function.

f_hd_compressor_unit.name: high pressure compressor unit
f_hd_compressor_unit.description: A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  It needs large amounts of power to function.

f_deep_fryer.name: deep fryer
f_deep_fryer.description: An industrial deep fryer, for frying huge batches of food at once.  You could take this down and use it for your own purposes if you wanted.

f_barricade_road.name: road barricade
f_barricade_road.description: A large wooden blockade used to block passage through a road.  It is lined with reflective tape to increase visibility.  Despite the name, it does little to stop a moving car.

f_gravelbag_half.name: gravelbag barricade
f_gravelbag_half.description: A low wall made of stacked gravelbags, uncommonly used to catch bullets and block flooding.

f_gravelbag_wall.name: gravelbag wall
f_gravelbag_wall.description: A wall of stacked gravelbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

f_earthbag_half.name: earthbag barricade
f_earthbag_half.description: A low wall made of stacked earthbags, commonly used to catch bullets and block flooding.

f_earthbag_wall.name: earthbag wall
f_earthbag_wall.description: A wall of stacked earthbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

f_lane.name: lane guard
f_lane.description: A simple wooden post to mark the separation between street lanes.

f_sandbag_half.name: sandbag barricade
f_sandbag_half.description: A low wall made of canvas sacks filled with sand, commonly used to catch bullets and prevent flooding.

f_sandbag_wall.name: sandbag wall
f_sandbag_wall.description: A wall of stacked sandbags, a bit taller than an average adult.

f_showjump.name: show jump
f_showjump.description: A show jump made of a long pole, suitable for showing off your equestrian skills.

f_showjump_end.name: show jump
f_showjump_end.description: The end of a show jump made of planks.

f_beach_seaweed.name: scattered seaweed
f_beach_seaweed.description: Seaweed and other detritus, scattered along the high water line of the beach.

f_beach_log.name: driftwood
f_beach_log.description: A hollow and twisted piece of a root or a branch, bleached white by sun and salt.

f_bigmirror.name: standing mirror
f_bigmirror.description: A full-length mirror mounted in a sleek aluminum frame.  You can easily see all of the dirt and blood on your clothes, and the weariness in your eyes.

f_bigmirror_b.name: broken standing mirror
f_bigmirror_b.description: An aluminum frame for a full-length mirror, with most of the mirror missing.  What remains in the frame are large, dangerous-looking shards of fractured glass.

f_bitts.name: bitts
f_bitts.description: A pair of vertical iron posts mounted on a wharf, pier, or other form of dock.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, and similar.

f_cleat.name: cleat
f_cleat.description: A small horn cleat with two "horns" extending parallel to the deck or the axis of the spar, and resembling a small anvil.  They are used to secure mooring lines, ropes, and similar.

f_shackle.name: manacles
f_shackle.description: A pair of metal shackles with heavy chains mounted to a wall or floor.

f_statue.name: statue
f_statue.description: A massive block of stone that has been carefully carved into a work of timeless art.

f_highlands_holy_statue.name: statue
f_highlands_holy_statue.description: All fine details have been eroded away by the passing of time, leaving only a rough humanoid shape carved from dark stone.

f_highlands_gatekeeper_statue.name: statue of a gatekeeper
f_highlands_gatekeeper_statue.description: A demonic figure carved from dark stone stands guard over the bronze pillars ahead.  It holds a bronze censer with one outstretched hand, while the other points upwards into the sky.

f_mannequin.name: mannequin
f_mannequin.description: A life-size wooden figure of a person, most commonly used to display clothing in stores, or for tailors to design outfits on.  Considering all that's happened, something about it is somewhat unnerving.

f_birdbath.name: birdbath
f_birdbath.description: A wide stone bowl mounted to a pedestal, usually filled with rainwater, meant for birds to play or bathe in.

f_gazing_ball.name: gazing ball
f_gazing_ball.description: A mirrored glass globe mounted on a cement pedestal.  It warps your reflection when you look into it.

f_rotary_clothesline.name: rotary clothes dryer line
f_rotary_clothesline.description: A central metal pole holding up a wide rotating frame, this would be used to hang up clothes to dry in the sunlight.

f_floor_lamp.name: standing lamp
f_floor_lamp.description: A light mounted on the top of a metal pole, this would be plugged into a wall socket to illuminate a room.

f_lighthouse_light.name: lighthouse light
f_lighthouse_light.description: Very high power, modern lighthouse LED light source with attached heatsinks.

f_winter_wreath.name: pine wreath
f_winter_wreath.description: A decorative wreath for the winter holidays.

f_sand_castle.name: sand castle
f_sand_castle.description: A glorious castle made of sand.  This mighty fortress will stand tall for the ages to come, a true testament to the skills of its builder.

f_decorative_tree.name: decorative tree
f_decorative_tree.description: A decorative pine tree littered with ornaments for the winter holidays.

f_styling_station.name: styling station
f_styling_station.description: A styling station, is a countertop with a mirror mounted above it and just enough room and cubbies to store a stylist's equipment on it.

f_indoor_flagpole.name: indoor flagpole
f_indoor_flagpole.description: A 2.5-meter tall flagpole on a weighted stand.  You could hoist up a flag here.

f_indoor_flagpole_wooden.name: wooden indoor flagpole
f_indoor_flagpole_wooden.description: A 2.5-meter tall wooden flagpole on a weighted stand.  You could hoist up a flag here.

f_indoor_plant.name: indoor plant
f_indoor_plant.description: A small potted plant, used for decoration indoors.  It appears to have dried up and died a while ago.

f_indoor_plant_y.name: yellow indoor plant
f_indoor_plant_y.description: A decorative potted plant with a yellow flower, it looks to have wilted and died some time ago.

f_plant_unharvested_overgrown.name: overgrown plant
f_plant_unharvested_overgrown.description: This patch of green used to be a cultivated field or some sort of monocrop agriculture.  Neglected for too long, it has been overtaken by nature.

f_plant_harvest.name: harvestable plant
f_plant_harvest.description: This plant is fully grown and ready to be harvested.  Identifying how to harvest it requires closer examination.

f_plant_mature.name: mature plant
f_plant_mature.description: This plant has matured, and will be ready to harvest before long.

f_plant_seed.name: seed
f_plant_seed.description: A freshly planted seed.  If properly tended to, it could grow into a healthy plant.

f_plant_seedling.name: seedling
f_plant_seedling.description: A seed that has just begun to sprout its first roots.

f_planter.name: planter
f_planter.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  Can be used for planting crops.

f_planter_unharvested_overgrown.name: planter with dead plants
f_planter_unharvested_overgrown.description: Somewhere beneath this heap of dying plants you can see the shape of wooden furniture.  Left without care, the plants it used to nurture have shriveled and died.

f_planter_harvest.name: planter with harvestable plant
f_planter_harvest.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a fully grown plant, and will need closer examination to harvest.

f_planter_mature.name: planter with mature plant
f_planter_mature.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a matured plant that should be ready for harvest before long.

f_planter_seed.name: planter with seed
f_planter_seed.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one contains a planted seed, and will need attention to grow fully.

f_planter_seedling.name: planter with seedling
f_planter_seedling.description: A garden planter full of soil and slatted to allow adequate drainage.  This one has a seed that has just begun to sprout its first roots.

f_stook_full.name: grain stook
f_stook_full.description: Sheaves of cut grain have been stood upright in a self-supporting A-frame to dry, keeping the seeds off the ground and out of reach of vermin.

f_stook_empty.name: stooking spot
f_stook_empty.description: A space has been cleared out here for grain drying.  Place fresh stalks of grain in this spot and examine to set up a stook.

f_egg_sackbw.name: spider egg sac
f_egg_sackbw.description: A sizable, off-white sac of large eggs.  Upon watching closer, you can see them moving slightly.  Gross.

f_egg_sackcs.name: spider egg sac
f_egg_sackcs.description: A bulbous mass of off-white spider eggs.  Upon watching closer, you can see them moving a bit.  Really gross.

f_egg_sackws.name: spider egg sac
f_egg_sackws.description: A gigantic sac of spider eggs, each one larger than your fist.  They're definitely moving around.  Really gross, just seeing it makes your skin crawl.

f_egg_sacke.name: ruptured egg sac
f_egg_sacke.description: A disgusting, ruptured sac of giant spider eggs.  The thought of all those massive baby spiders pouring out of it is almost terrifying on its own.

f_swamp_gas.name: swamp gas
f_swamp_gas.description: A pool of murky water that occasionally bubbles, releasing a mildly toxic gas.

f_vent_cold_air2_stream.name: metal grate
f_vent_cold_air2_stream.description: A metal vent.  You can feel cool air seeping out of it.

f_vent_cold_air2_blast.name: metal grate
f_vent_cold_air2_blast.description: A metal vent.  You can feel cold air blasting out of it.

f_vent_hot_air2_stream.name: metal grate
f_vent_hot_air2_stream.description: A metal vent.  You can feel hot air seeping out of it.

f_vent_hot_air2_blast.name: metal grate
f_vent_hot_air2_blast.description: A metal vent.  You can feel hot air seeping out of it.

f_vent_toxic_leak.name: metal grate
f_vent_toxic_leak.description: A metal vent.  Toxic-looking clouds seep from it.

f_vent_toxic_belch.name: metal grate
f_vent_toxic_belch.description: A metal vent.  Toxic-looking clouds stream from it.

f_fog_breather.name: fog
f_fog_breather.description: A misty cloud of water vapor.

f_clear.name: seeing this is a bug
f_clear.description: Seeing this is a bug.  If seen, please report and destroy.

f_fake_bench_hands.name: fake workbench hands
f_fake_bench_hands.description: This fake workbench holds the stats for working on a wielded item.

f_ground_crafting_spot.name: ground crafting spot
f_ground_crafting_spot.description: A cleared spot on the ground for crafting.  Slower than using a workbench or holding a project in your hands, but readily available.

f_no_item.name: seeing this is a bug
f_no_item.description: Seeing this is a bug.  If seen, please report and destroy.

f_fireplace.name: fireplace
f_fireplace.description: A common fixture for safely hosting a fire indoors, with a chimney to vent the smoke to the outside.

f_fireplace_stone.name: stone fireplace
f_fireplace_stone.description: A common fixture for safely hosting a fire indoors, with a chimney to vent the smoke to the outside.

f_woodstove.name: wood stove
f_woodstove.description: A simple metal stove for hosting wood-fueled fires.  Good for cooking or heating food, and safe to use indoors.

f_brazier.name: brazier
f_brazier.description: A raised metal dish in which to safely burn things.

f_makeshift_brazier.name: makeshift brazier
f_makeshift_brazier.description: A metal bucket with holes, in which you can safely start a fire.  It's too small to fit any fuel item larger than some splintered wood.

f_hobo_stove.name: hobo stove
f_hobo_stove.description: A small improvised wood stove, made from a metal can.  It's too small to fit any fuel much larger than splintered wood.

f_portable_stove.name: portable stove
f_portable_stove.description: A foldable metal stove for hosting wood-fueled fires.  Good for cooking or heating food, and safe to use indoors.

f_55gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (200 L)
f_55gal_firebarrel.description: A huge metal barrel used to safely contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in the sides for air supply.

f_30gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (100 L)
f_30gal_firebarrel.description: A large metal barrel used to safely contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in the sides for air supply.

f_firering.name: fire ring
f_firering.description: A ring of stones to safely contain a fire.

f_clay_oven.name: clay oven
f_clay_oven.description: A simple clay oven with a chimney, with a firebrick alcove in the middle that can be used to cook food or just to contain a fire.

f_solar_cooker.name: parabolic solar cooker
f_solar_cooker.description: A faceted reflector dish on a tripod that concentrates sunlight into a focal point for cooking.  Only works outdoors in strong direct sunlight.

f_algae_red.name: red algae
f_algae_red.description: One of the thousands of species of grassy reddish marine plants that inhabit intertidal zones the world over.  Its rubbery little fronds don't look particularly edible.

f_algae_green.name: green algae
f_algae_green.description: A short patch of grassy green seaweed, wholly unremarkable.

f_kelp_sugar.name: sugar kelp
f_kelp_sugar.description: Also known as kombu, this brown algae grows in a single leaflike blade that can reach more than twice the height of a man.  Young fronds make for excellent soup stock and can even be eaten raw.

f_sea_lettuce.name: sea lettuce
f_sea_lettuce.description: Sometimes known as green laver, this leafy algae from the Ulva genus grows in leafy little patches around shallows and tide pools.  Though small, it makes a tasty snack.

f_bladderwrack.name: bladderwrack
f_bladderwrack.description: Named for the air bladders that grow all over its leafy fronds, this leafy seaweed is technically edible and has a long history of use in folk medicine.

f_sea_anemone.name: sea anemone
f_sea_anemone.description: This sessile polyp waves its stinging tentacles with the motion of the tides, hoping to capture a tiny fish or crab.  It's wholly inedible and poses no danger to anything bigger than a shrimp.

f_sea_sponge.name: sea sponge
f_sea_sponge.description: An immobile, lumpy little creature that looks nothing like a square kitchen sponge.  Anchored to the sea floor, its porous body passively filters plankton from the water that freely passes through it.

f_mutpoppy.name: mutated poppy flower
f_mutpoppy.description: These strange flowers have appeared in the wake of the Cataclysm, and their buds can be used for medicinal purposes, like the buds of the mundane poppy they're named after.  The dirt around it gently churns as its roots writhe beneath the soil, and it's surrounded by an overwhelming floral smell that makes you feel sleepy.

f_dandelion.name: dandelion
f_dandelion.description: A common weed with a yellow flower.  Produces seeds that get carried on the wind by thin, gray filaments.

f_burdock.name: burdock
f_burdock.description: A common weed with a purple thistle-like flower.  Its seeds tend to stick to clothing and fur.

f_carrot_wild.name: wild carrot
f_carrot_wild.description: A common white wildflower which could be harvested for its root.

f_asparagus_wild.name: wild asparagus
f_asparagus_wild.description: A perennial plant cultivated for its young edible shoots, commonly called spears.  When raw and growing naturally, the plant has a distinctive appearance that changes through its life cycle.

f_maianthemum_stellatum.name: starry false Solomon's seal
f_maianthemum_stellatum.description: The blossoms of this flower look like stars in the night sky.  Its crimson berries are edible.

f_salsify.name: salsify
f_salsify.description: Tragopogon porrifolius, a ragged-looking purple flower with a nutritious root.

f_chamomile.name: chamomile
f_chamomile.description: A cute white flower with a yellow center, used to brew a soothing tea.

f_flower_tulip.name: tulip
f_flower_tulip.description: A bright, colorful flower with petals forming a small cup at its top.  It can be poisonous to livestock.

f_flower_spurge.name: spurge flower
f_flower_spurge.description: A yellow-green flower that grows in densely-packed bushes.

f_cattails.name: cattails
f_cattails.description: This useful plant is available all year round.  Many parts of the plant are edible.

f_black_eyed_susan.name: black eyed Susan
f_black_eyed_susan.description: A mildly poisonous yellow flower with a dark ball in the middle.  Sometimes known as an ox-eye daisy.

f_lily.name: lily
f_lily.description: A pretty flower that comes in a variety of colors.

f_lotus.name: lotus
f_lotus.description: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of fresh water.  A traditional symbol of many Eastern cultures.

f_sunflower.name: sunflower
f_sunflower.description: A tall, wide-headed flower with a large dark center.  Produces many nutritious seeds.

f_jerusalem_artichoke.name: Jerusalem artichoke plant
f_jerusalem_artichoke.description: Looking similar to a sunflower, this tall plant has a nutritious tuber.

f_lilypad.name: lilypad
f_lilypad.description: This lilypad doesn't look like it would support the weight of the things you've heard croaking in the swamp.

f_dahlia.name: dahlia
f_dahlia.description: A puffy flower with many tightly-layered petals.

f_chicory.name: chicory
f_chicory.description: A blue flower imported from Europe, also known as a cornflower.

f_leaves_pile.name: pile of leaves
f_leaves_pile.description: A sizable pile of leaves.  You could sleep on it if you don't care about comfort or warmth.

f_mustard.name: mustard
f_mustard.description: A yellow flower known as Brassica Nigra.  Known for its seeds that can be used for making table mustard.

f_wild_sarsaparilla.name: wild sarsaparilla
f_wild_sarsaparilla.description: A small, flowering plant known as 'Aralia nudicaulis'.  It is colored in vibrant shades of orange and red in autumn, making it easy to spot.

f_wintergreen.name: wintergreen
f_wintergreen.description: A small shrub native to North America.  The leaves, which remain green even in winter, are valued for medicinal purposes.  It produces edible and sweet berries, too!

f_japanese_knotweed.name: Japanese knotweed
f_japanese_knotweed.description: An invasive species originating from Japan.  The stem looks like it might contain some water.

f_fireweed.name: fireweed
f_fireweed.description: Vibrant purple, it tends to be the first to appear after fires, hence its name.

f_selfheal.name: common selfheal
f_selfheal.description: A small purple flower.  It got its name due to its usage in traditional medicine.

f_dogbane.name: spreading dogbane
f_dogbane.description: It is not only toxic to dogs when eaten by them.  Humans and many other animals are affected, too.  Its fibers sure are worth salvaging though.  Despite its name, it is not actually spreading fast.

f_thistle.name: thistle
f_thistle.description: A prickly and invasive small plant.

f_purple_loosestrife.name: purple loosestrife
f_purple_loosestrife.description: A pretty violet flower that likes water.  Unfortunately it is invasive and does not benefit the environment.

f_wild_rice.name: wild rice
f_wild_rice.description: Also called Indian rice, Northern wild rice, or manoomin in Ojibwe, is a species of rice that has been harvested and used by Native American tribes of the northeast for hundreds of years.  It's similar to other types of wild rice, offering a fiber-rich and healthy basis of a meal.

f_hedge_short.name: short hedge
f_hedge_short.description: A shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a squared shape.

f_hedge_tall.name: tall hedge
f_hedge_tall.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a squared shape.  You can't see past this thick hedgerow.

f_topiary_abstract.name: abstract topiary
f_topiary_abstract.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a fanciful abstract shape.

f_topiary_animal.name: animal topiary
f_topiary_animal.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into an animal shape.

f_topiary_dragon.name: animal topiary
f_topiary_dragon.description: A tall shrub with small green leaves, trimmed into a dragon shape.

f_beaver_dam.name: dam
f_beaver_dam.description: A house that beavers built.  The entrance is underwater making it harder for predators to access.

f_flower_marloss.name: Marloss flower
f_flower_marloss.description: This flower looks mostly like the other flowers taken by the mushrooms, but its bulb is a brilliant cyan color.  It emits an aroma that is both overwhelming and strangely alluring.

f_flower_fungal.name: fungal flower
f_flower_fungal.description: This flower has been overgrown by gray, sinewy tendrils of fungus, and the color has been leached from its petals and stem.  It gently sways of its own volition, maintaining an unsettling rhythm.

f_fungal_mass.name: fungal mass
f_fungal_mass.description: Thick ropes of Mycal matter have covered the ground here completely.  It's soft to the touch, but not firm enough to hold any weight.

f_fungal_clump.name: fungal clump
f_fungal_clump.description: Alien mold and stems mingle tightly here, swaying around and weaving together, creating a sort of fungal bush.

f_fungal_tangle.name: fungal tangle
f_fungal_tangle.description: Thick, ropy tendrils of fungus have risen from the ground and gathered into an impenetrable clump.

f_slab.name: stone slab
f_slab.description: A slab of heavy stone, with a reasonably flat surface.

f_highland_sarcophagus.name: stone sarcophagus
f_highland_sarcophagus.description: A large stone coffin, adorned with reliefs depicting figures in various poses of mourning.  The lid is firmly sealed, and the interior is inaccessible.

f_highland_sarcophagus_o.name: broken stone sarcophagus
f_highland_sarcophagus_o.description: A large stone coffin, adorned with reliefs depicting figures in various poses of mourning.  Its been desecrated and looted.

f_imperial_sarcophagus.name: royal sarcophagus
f_imperial_sarcophagus.description: An army of ossified figures marches across the four sides of this massive stone coffin, their procession led by a regal figure whose features are obscured by a veil.  The lid is firmly sealed, and whatever lies within is inaccessible.

f_imperial_sarcophagus_o.name: broken royal sarcophagus
f_imperial_sarcophagus_o.description: Pieces of the stone reliefs are scattered across the floor, and the lid has been shattered to allow access to the interior.

f_grave_head.name: headstone
f_grave_head.description: A large slab of stone, engraved with information on the deceased individual buried beneath.  While only a solemn reminder of the uncountable losses of the Cataclysm, a proper final resting place grants an odd sense of peace.

f_grave_stone.name: gravestone
f_grave_stone.description: An upright slab of stone with information engraved on the face about whoever lies beneath.  While only a solemn reminder of the countless casualties of the Cataclysm, a proper final resting place grants an odd sense of peace.

f_grave_stone_old.name: worn gravestone
f_grave_stone_old.description: An aged and eroded gravestone, damaged to the point of rendering the inscription illegible.  Whoever's buried here was probably lucky enough to pass before all this chaos began.

f_grave_monument.name: obelisk
f_grave_monument.description: A magnificent carved statue with an engraved plaque fixed to the base.  It serves to honor the passing of somebody significant, something one wishes was still a practical goal.

f_battlefield_cross.name: battlefield cross
f_battlefield_cross.description: A makeshift memorial marker, made of a service rifle - buried in the dirt, or nestled in a pair of boots - with a helmet perched on the stock.  A small way to honor the dead.

f_chemical_mixer.description: A large vat with a motorized mixing device for combining large quantities of chemicals.
f_chemical_mixer.name: chemical mixer

f_generator_broken.name: broken generator
f_generator_broken.description: This generator is broken and will not help you produce usable electricity.

f_compact_ASRG_containment.name: Compact Advanced Sterling Radioisotope Generator
f_compact_ASRG_containment.description: This hefty lump of steel and lead is the housing unit for a Stirling generator powered by plutonium-238, originally designed by NASA and repurposed by the military.  It is plastered with warning signs.  It's really heavy owing to the thick armor plating, but you could take this down and use it for your own purposes if you wanted.

f_xedra_antenna.name: mobile antenna
f_xedra_antenna.description: A stark black directional antenna, seemingly part of a monitoring setup.  An LED mounted on its back lights up with a lazy and irregular rhythm.

f_xedra_mobile_weather_station.name: mobile antenna
f_xedra_mobile_weather_station.description: A mix of mundane and otherworldly devices deployed from the top of a sleek black case.  It is equipped with a built-in analysis computer, a small thermal printer, and a rechargeable battery.  The case itself is outfitted with back straps and a telescoping stand.  "X.E.D.R.A." and "HE weather station" are engraved on the case.

f_machinery_light.name: light machinery
f_machinery_light.description: Assorted light machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

f_machinery_heavy.name: heavy machinery
f_machinery_heavy.description: Assorted heavy machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

f_machinery_old.name: old machinery
f_machinery_old.description: Assorted old, rusty machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

f_machinery_electronic.name: electronic machinery
f_machinery_electronic.description: Assorted electronic machinery.  You could scavenge it for parts.

f_robotic_arm.name: robotic arm
f_robotic_arm.description: An automated robotic arm used in assembly lines, which appears to be more general-purpose than specially designed assemblers.  Despite being functionless now, the parts could be useful.

f_ground_cable.name: ground cable
f_ground_cable.description: A bunch of loose cables snake along the floor.

f_electrical_conduit.name: electrical conduit
f_electrical_conduit.description: A thick bundle of electrical wiring protected by a metal conduit.

f_capacitor.name: capacitor bank
f_capacitor.description: A bank of heavy metal cylinders connected by large wires.

f_control_station.name: control station
f_control_station.description: Assorted electronic interfaces and screens.  You could scavenge it for parts.

f_nuclear_fuel_cell.name: nuclear fuel cell
f_nuclear_fuel_cell.description: This fuel assembly consists of cylindrical rods put into bundles.  A uranium oxide ceramic is formed into pellets and inserted into Zircaloy tubes that are bundled together.  The Zircaloy tubes are pressurized with helium to minimize pellet-cladding interaction which can lead to fuel rod failure over long periods.  This fuel cell is used in nuclear power stations to produce heat to power turbines.

f_metal_detector.name: metal detector
f_metal_detector.description: A metal detector like one you'd see at the airport.  This one is no longer functioning.

f_balthazar_server.name: Balthazar's server racks
f_balthazar_server.description: The servers Balthazar is running on.  Destroying these will severely damage, if not kill them.

f_autodoc.name: Autodoc Mk. XI
f_autodoc.description: A surgical apparatus used for the installation and removal of bionics.  The term name 'Autodoc' is something of a misnomer, as it can only operate if programmed beforehand, something that a plethora of labels warn against doing without expertise.

f_autodoc_couch.name: Autodoc operation couch
f_autodoc_couch.description: A plush red sofa made less comfortable by the medical machinery directly above it.  It has a single leather strap on the right armrest.

f_autoclave.name: autoclave
f_autoclave.description: A device that can steam its contents at high enough temperatures to completely sterilize them, killing any possible contaminants.

f_autoclave_full.name: filled autoclave
f_autoclave_full.description: A device that can steam its contents at high enough temperatures to completely sterilize them, killing any possible contaminants.

f_sample_freezer.name: sample freezer
f_sample_freezer.description: A specialized freezer capable of maintaining temperatures of -80 Celsius, best used for the preservation of delicate scientific samples.

f_lab_bench.name: lab workbench
f_lab_bench.description: A metal storage cabinet topped with a durable resin countertop resistant to most chemical spills and burns.  It has wired-in electrical and gas fittings.

f_fume_hood.description: A metal hood atop a lab workspace, with durable glass shutters.  A fan in the hood draws fumes and smoke from dangerous chemicals up into a ventilation duct.
f_fume_hood.name: fume hood

f_shaker.name: shaker incubator
f_shaker.description: A tool for keeping chemical broth nicely mixed and at just the right temperature to grow bacteria.  Although more bacteria is probably the last thing you need, considering the circumstances.

f_eyewash.name: emergency wash station
f_eyewash.description: A standing sink with a pair of nozzles, along with a large, brightly-colored handle.  It is specially designed to quickly remove contaminants from the eyes, and is easily usable without being able to see very well.  A sizable notice warns against drinking the water it uses.

f_IV_pole.name: IV pole
f_IV_pole.description: A tall wire frame on a set of small wheels used for holding an IV bag, useful for unattended administration.

f_HPLC.name: high-performance liquid chromatographer
f_HPLC.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a liquid or aqueous phase, based on their affinity, to the stationary phase in a tube.  At least, that's what the label says.

f_GC.name: gas chromatographer
f_GC.description: This high-tech tool would, with electricity and an experienced user, be a very useful way to separate chemicals in a gaseous phase, based on their affinity, to a stationary phase in a tube.  At least that's what the label says.

f_MS.name: mass spectrometer
f_MS.description: Inside this large white box is a carefully balanced set of electric field generators that can precisely separate ionized particles based on their charge-to-mass ratio, firing them into a detector that measures the exact mass of the particle hitting it.  Invaluable for chemical analysis and other advanced sciences, it's not as useful anymore.

f_NMR.name: nuclear magnetic resonance spectrometer
f_NMR.description: A giant electromagnet with carefully tuned measurement equipment used to observe how magnetic fields affect nuclear spins.  It is a common workhorse for the discovery and study of chemical structures.

f_electron_microscope.name: electron microscope
f_electron_microscope.description: An enormous observational tool for studying the details of samples on an immensely small scale.

f_CTscan.name: CT scanner
f_CTscan.description: A massive piece of machinery used to take hundreds of X-ray images from 360 degrees, often used for medical examinations.

f_MRI.name: MRI machine
f_MRI.description: A massive tool used to take NMR images of a patient placed inside, providing invaluable medical insight.

f_scan_bed.name: scanner bed
f_scan_bed.description: A narrow, flat, and frankly uncomfortable bed for putting someone into an imaging machine for medical observations.

f_anesthetic.name: anesthetic machine
f_anesthetic.description: A large machine with various tanks, tubes, and monitoring devices used to maintain precise levels of anesthesia in a patient to ensure they, at least ideally, remain asleep, unfeeling, but alive.

f_dialysis.name: dialysis machine
f_dialysis.description: A large machine for pumping and filtering the blood of somebody without the function of their kidneys.

f_ventilator.name: medical ventilator
f_ventilator.description: A sizable box on a set of wheels that will pump air in and out of a patient's lungs when they are incapable of breathing, though often only needed temporarily.

f_centrifuge.name: centrifuge
f_centrifuge.description: A centrifuge, a liquid separating device with an automated analyzer unit.

f_xray.name: X-ray scanner
f_xray.description: A table with a movable head, often used for medical examinations.

f_dental_xray.name: dental X-ray machine
f_dental_xray.description: A device for creating radiographic images of the teeth.

f_exam_chair.name: exam chair
f_exam_chair.description: A medical exam chair with an overhead light, bolted to the floor.

f_pallet_brick.name: pallet of bricks
f_pallet_brick.description: A massive, packed-together block of bricks wrapped with plastic packaging.  It makes for easy storage of building materials for masonry constructions.

f_pallet_brick_adobe.name: pallet of adobe bricks
f_pallet_brick_adobe.description: A massive, packed-together block of adobe bricks wrapped with plastic packaging.  It makes for easy storage of building materials for masonry constructions.

f_pallet_cement.name: pallet of cement bags
f_pallet_cement.description: A massive, packed-together block of cement bags wrapped with plastic packaging.  It makes for easy storage of building materials for masonry constructions.

f_stack_plank.name: stack of wooden planks
f_stack_plank.description: Dozens of construction planks tied together for easier transport.  Deconstruct to untie them.

f_bathtub.name: bathtub
f_bathtub.description: An ordinary ceramic tub, with a now-functionless steel faucet and a plug fixed over the drain.  Watertight and relatively clean, it would make for a good water trough.

f_shower.name: shower
f_shower.description: A small enclosed ceramic room with a glass door and plumbing fixtures for cleaning oneself.  Before it was a commonplace amenity, but now it's hard to imagine wasting that much water.

f_sink.name: sink
f_sink.description: A porcelain water basin with a water tap and drain, designed to be fitted into an opening on a countertop.

f_sink_gravity.name: sink with gravity-feed tank
f_sink_gravity.description: A water basin with flowing water, fed by a tank suspended above.  A luxury when the water main is unavailable.  This one has a hand pump to refill from groundwater.

f_toilet.name: toilet
f_toilet.description: An invaluable fixture in any home, it would be a miracle to have one that works.  The standing tank may hold a moderate amount of water, but while better than anything that would be in the bowl, it would not be the cleanest.

f_water_heater.name: water heater
f_water_heater.description: An insulated metal tank with a small fire used to maintain near-boiling temperatures.  There's no longer any way to power it, but any water left in the large tank from before the power went out should be pretty clean, and it could be used to store large quantities of other liquids too.

f_water_heater_family.name: family–sized water heater
f_water_heater_family.description: An insulated metal tank with a small fire used to maintain near-boiling temperatures.  There's no longer any way to power it, but any water left in the large tank from before the power went out should be pretty clean, and it could be used to store large quantities of other liquids too.

f_water_purifier.name: water purifier
f_water_purifier.description: This device effectively sterilizes water.  You can plug it into a power grid to use it.

f_exercise.name: exercise machine
f_exercise.description: A heavy set of weightlifting equipment for strength training, with a pair of heavy weights affixed to opposite ends of a sturdy pipe.  You can adjust the set by hand-picking the weights you wish to use.

f_ball_mach.name: ball machine
f_ball_mach.description: A simple machine for launching sports balls of various types, with a pair of motorized wheels that, if spun up, would fling the ball at moderate speeds.  Probably not the most effective ranged weapon against the undead.

f_parkour_bars.name: parkour bars
f_parkour_bars.description: A complicated set of monkey bars, to be used by adults to train parkour.

f_pool_table.name: pool table
f_pool_table.description: A large wooden table with green felt carpeting on top, and a set of symmetrical holes that carry billiard balls to an opening on one side.  While not a good substitute for a normal table, you could take it apart for a substantial amount of wood.

f_dive_block.name: diving block
f_dive_block.description: A chunky plastic stool bolted onto the ground, intended as a safe way of diving forward into a body of water.

f_target.name: target
f_target.description: A long sheet of metal, cut into a roughly human shape and held upright by a pipe frame.  There are two bullseye targets painted onto it, a large one on the torso, and a smaller one on the head.  It is peppered with small dents and holes, and a large amount of the paint has flaked or chipped off.

f_arcade_machine.name: arcade machine
f_arcade_machine.description: A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Useless for its intended purpose without power, it's bound to have valuable parts.

f_pinball_machine.name: pinball machine
f_pinball_machine.description: An iconic game, this machine has a brightly decorated background on its intricate obstacle course, which is covered by a long sheet of glass.  While inoperable without power, it's still impressive to look at, though probably more useful if disassembled.

f_ergometer.name: ergometer
f_ergometer.description: An exercise machine with a set of handles and plates meant to emulate rowing a boat.  Without power it can't be operated, but it might have useful parts to be scavenged.

f_ergometer_mechanical.name: mechanical ergometer
f_ergometer_mechanical.description: An exercise machine with a set of handles and plates meant to emulate rowing a boat.  This an older model with mechanical resistance adjustments, so it works without power.

f_treadmill.name: treadmill
f_treadmill.description: A motorized conveyor belt with a control panel for running in place.  Without power, it's an immense challenge to move the belt.  Regardless, you're probably getting enough cardio on your own.

f_treadmill_mechanical.name: gravity treadmill
f_treadmill_mechanical.description: A gravity-driven conveyor belt with a mechanical control panel for running in place.  The belt is positioned on an adjustable incline, so it slides back under your weight without needing to be powered.

f_punching_bag.name: heavy punching bag
f_punching_bag.description: A hefty, oblong leather bag, suspended from a ceiling mount with a steel chain.  It can be used for exercise and combat training, with the notable advantage that it doesn't fight back.

f_piano.name: piano
f_piano.description: An elegant piano, capable of producing beautiful music if used by a skilled player.  A set of off-white and black keys are linked to a set of hammers, which strike their corresponding tightly-coiled wire to produce sound.

f_speaker_cabinet.name: speaker cabinet
f_speaker_cabinet.description: An upright wood-panel case of large speakers, built to produce a potentially deafening volume level.  While it would be a terrible idea to use this now, it could hold useful parts.

f_dancing_pole.name: dancing pole
f_dancing_pole.description: A tall steel pipe mounted vertically, securely fastened to the ceiling and floor.  Usually used for various forms of dancing, often in adult-oriented venues.

f_roulette_table.name: roulette table
f_roulette_table.description: A huge table specially made for a specific form of gambling, with a grid painted onto the felt top, and a concave spinning wheel intended to give a random selection of the inscribed possibilities.

f_organ.name: pipe organ
f_organ.description: A majestic pipe organ.  Dubbed "the king of instruments", it is capable of producing powerful sound harmonies if used by a skilled player.  Rows of off-white and black keys are linked to a set of iron pipes, which resonate at a specific pitch when pressurized air is driven through them.

f_training_dummy_light.name: training dummy
f_training_dummy_light.description: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is made from wood and has some duct tape to mark the striking points.  It has been erected in the ground on its post.

f_training_dummy_heavy.name: armored training dummy
f_training_dummy_heavy.description: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is covered in scrap armor and looks on guard.  It has been erected in the ground on its post.

f_archery_target_box.name: box archery target
f_archery_target_box.description: A soft target for archery consisting of tightly-packed cloth stuffed into a cardboard box, with a bullseye marked on the front.

f_archery_target_bale.name: bale archery target
f_archery_target_bale.description: A soft target for archery consisting of a bale of hay with a bullseye marked on the front.

f_region_flower.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_flower.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_weed.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_weed.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_water_plant.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_water_plant.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_plain.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_plain.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_forest.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_forest.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_forest_dense.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_forest_dense.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_forest_water.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_forest_water.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_flower_decorative.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_flower_decorative.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_lake_bed.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_lake_bed.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_region_ocean_bed.name: pseudo furniture
f_region_ocean_bed.description: This should never actually show up, it should have been replaced with regional furniture.

f_cellphone_booster.name: cell phone signal booster
f_cellphone_booster.description: A specialized piece of equipment that receives phone signals and amplifies them to reach further destinations with more clarity.  Now that there's no longer signals for them to boost, they're only good for parts.

f_small_satellite_dish.name: satellite dish
f_small_satellite_dish.description: A small sheet metal disc designed to receive radio waves from orbital satellites.  Satellites that will assuredly continue to orbit, with nothing to broadcast.

f_chimney.name: chimney crown
f_chimney.description: The top of a brick chimney, the opening is stained black with soot.  Definitely too narrow to fit in.

f_TV_antenna.name: TV antenna
f_TV_antenna.description: A simple metal antenna to increase the reception of non-cable television broadcasts.  Almost wholly obsolete for years, only being good for parts isn't new for this item.

f_vent_pipe.name: vent pipe
f_vent_pipe.description: A sort of chimney spout for a building's internal ventilation system, this can be used for circulation, venting fumes, and other such functions.

f_wind_vane.name: wind vane
f_wind_vane.description: A metal fin that swivels around a central pivot, indicating the direction of prevailing wind.

f_roof_turbine_vent.name: roof turbine vent
f_roof_turbine_vent.description: A rotary wind turbine that will catch the wind and pull out air from inside.  It is most commonly used for improving air circulation, particularly in poorly-ventilated areas like attics.

f_hay.name: bale of hay
f_hay.description: A massive packed-together block of hay, it makes for easy storage of straw for livestock.  If your only other option is the floor, it makes a tolerable bed.

f_woodchips.name: pile of woodchips
f_woodchips.description: A large mound of piled wood chips.  Unpleasant to lay on, hard to walk through, and a large fire hazard, it's probably best to shovel it out of the way.

f_bench.name: bench
f_bench.description: A simple bench with wood slats nailed to a frame.  While uncomfortably flat and just as cold as the ground, it could serve as a bed if needed.

f_armchair.name: armchair
f_armchair.description: A simple upholstered chair with armrests.  Soft and fairly warm, it definitely beats the ground for sleeping on, though not by much.

f_seat_airplane.name: airplane seat
f_seat_airplane.description: A cheaply-upholstered folding airplane seat, it has a simple across-the-lap seatbelt.  You likely wouldn't be the first to sleep in this.

f_chair.name: wooden chair
f_chair.description: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.

f_sofa.name: sofa
f_sofa.description: A wide upholstered bench, large enough for two people to comfortably sit alongside one another, or for one person to lay down on.  It's not quite a bed, but it's a hell of a lot more comfortable than the floor.

f_stool.name: wooden stool
f_stool.description: A simple stool with four legs and a seat.  While it's a touch more maneuverable to sit on, the lack of back support means it's significantly less comfortable than a normal chair.

f_camp_chair.name: camp chair
f_camp_chair.description: A somewhat uncomfortable folding chair, with fabric strung across a metal frame.  Not the best, but better than nothing, and very easy to pack up for transport.

f_logstool.name: log stool
f_logstool.description: A short section of a tree trunk with one of the flat ends smoothed down.  Makes for a decent place to sit, but not quite a real chair.

f_deckchair.name: deck chair
f_deckchair.description: A folding deck chair with fabric sheets mounted to a wooden frame.  While it's built to handle outdoor conditions and is an improvement over the ground, it's not particularly comfortable.

f_metal_bench.name: metal bench
f_metal_bench.description: A bench made of metal.  Not the most comfortable furniture you've ever sat on.

f_bench_wooden.name: wooden bench
