f_bench_wooden.description: A simple wooden bench made of two thick, makeshift legs and a flat piece of wood on top.  Certainly nowhere near as good as a bed, but sitting on it makes you feel like you're out camping.

f_bench_park.name: park bench
f_bench_park.description: A wooden bench with a metal frame and a back support.  Cold and uncomfortable to sleep on, but sitting on it is not terrible.

f_barstool.name: bar stool
f_barstool.description: A bar stool with a leather seat on a steel support.  Not practical for sleeping at all, but it does feel nicer than sitting on the ground.

f_chair_folding.name: folding chair
f_chair_folding.description: A black foldable plastic chair on a steel frame.  Not particularly comfortable, but at least you have something to sit on.

f_chair_plywood.name: plywood chair
f_chair_plywood.description: A simple chair made of plywood on a steel frame.  Quite uncomfortable, but it works for sleeping if it's the only option available.

f_chair_black.name: black wooden chair
f_chair_black.description: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair is painted black.

f_chair_white.name: white wooden chair
f_chair_white.description: A simple wooden chair with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair is painted white.

f_barber_chair.name: barber chair
f_barber_chair.description: a stationary chair made of cloth and steel.  With adjustable height and the ability to swing.

f_beanbag.name: bean bag
f_beanbag.description: A large cushion filled with beads often used as a seat.

f_bulletin.name: bulletin board
f_bulletin.description: A wide wooden frame with a sheet of corkboard inside.  Good for pinning various notices for other survivors to read.

f_sign.name: sign
f_sign.description: A simple signpost made of wood.  Basically two planks alongside each other nailed to another plank that holds them up.

f_sign_warning.name: warning sign
f_sign_warning.description: A triangular signpost painted white with a red border.  Designed to easily catch the eye, signs of this nature seldom display anything but bad news.

f_bulletin_evac.name: evac shelter info board
f_bulletin_evac.description: A wide wooden frame surrounding a sheet of cork, on to which a number of full-page notices have been neatly tacked.  Most seem to provide emergency information, or instructions now woefully outdated considering the state of things, but a map pointing to the nearest refugee center catches your eye.  You should take a closer look.

then.u_message: You study the board.  It shows a similar set of directions to the ones you already have.  You cross-reference them and don't learn anything new.

else.u_message: You study the board.  One of the pages has a map and address for a nearby refugee center alongside minutia you no longer need trouble yourself with now that society has collapsed, like 'operating hours' and 'acceptable forms of ID'.  You take careful note of the map on the board and mark down the coordinates.

f_sign_stop.name: stop sign
f_sign_stop.description: An octagonal red sign on a long metal pole, marked with the word STOP.

f_bed.name: bed
f_bed.description: A standard mattress on a sturdy wooden frame.  Even without blankets or pillows, and despite being a completely ordinary mattress, it's a sight for sore, tired eyes.

f_bunkbed.name: bunk bed
f_bunkbed.description: A bunk bed with a sturdy wooden frame built to hold two single-person mattresses above one another.  While these usually mean sleeping closer than you'd like to somebody you wouldn't normally want to share a mattress with, a bed's a bed.

f_bed_down.name: down bed
f_bed_down.description: A down mattress on a sturdy wooden frame.  Even without blankets or pillows, and despite being a completely ordinary mattress, it's a sight for sore, tired eyes.

f_bunkbed_down.name: down bunkbed
f_bunkbed_down.description: A bunk bed with a sturdy wooden frame built to hold two single-person mattresses above one another.  While these usually mean sleeping closer than you'd like to somebody you wouldn't normally want to share a mattress with, a bed's a bed.  This one has two down mattresses.

f_triple_bunkbed.name: triple berth
f_triple_bunkbed.description: This bunk bed can hold three people at once - a perfect sleeping solution for places where empty space is at a premium.

f_bed_frame.name: bed frame
f_bed_frame.description: A sturdy wooden bed frame built to hold most standard mattresses.  Despite being one half of a bed, it's just about impossible to lay on by itself.

f_floor_mattress.name: mattress
f_floor_mattress.description: An ordinary mattress lying on the floor.  While it's not as comfortable as a proper bed with a frame, it's pretty close.  If it's somewhere actually safe to sleep, this is practically a luxury in and of itself.

f_down_mattress.name: down mattress
f_down_mattress.description: A squishy, feather-stuffed mattress lying on the floor.  While it's not as comfortable as a proper bed with a frame, it's pretty close.  If it's somewhere actually safe to sleep, this is practically a luxury in and of itself.

f_hammock.name: hammock
f_hammock.description: A large sheet of cloth with ropes on two sides tied to nearby objects.  It's quite comfortable to sleep in, but provides no warmth.

f_hammock_net.name: net hammock
f_hammock_net.description: A large net with ropes on two sides tied to nearby objects.  It's quite comfortable to sleep in, but provides no warmth.

f_makeshift_bed.name: makeshift bed
f_makeshift_bed.description: An improvised mattress on a flimsy wooden frame.  Almost as good as a normal bed, albeit with a slightly lumpy mattress.  Considering the circumstances, it's not too bad at all.

f_straw_bed.name: straw bed
f_straw_bed.description: An improvised bedding pile made of hay.  Better than nothing, but not particularly comfortable, and quite itchy.

f_bookcase.name: bookcase
f_bookcase.description: A simple wooden shelf for storing dozens of books.  While designed for books, it does a decent job of storing anything else that'll fit.

f_entertainment_center.name: entertainment center
f_entertainment_center.description: While not quite as cool by itself as the name might imply, this large wooden cabinet can store a variety of things, like a TV and media systems, with shelving space and cupboards for anything that'll fit.

f_coffin_c.name: coffin
f_coffin_c.description: A humble wooden casket for the respectful burial of the dead.  While a standard practice before this all happened, it is now a rare honor for one to be given a proper final resting place.  An honor that countless many will likely never receive.

prying_data.failure: You pry, but the coffin remains closed.

f_coffin_o.name: open coffin
f_coffin_o.description: A humble wooden casket for the respectful burial of the dead.  While a standard practice before this all happened, it is now a rare honor for one to be given a proper final resting place.  This one is open and unoccupied, and gazing inside fills you with a sense of melancholic weariness.

f_crate_c.name: crate
f_crate_c.description: A sealed wooden storage container.  Lacking any labels, it could hold just about anything inside.  If you don't have a proper tool to pry it open, smashing it is an option, albeit one that risks destroying the contents.

prying_data.failure: You pry, but can't pop open the crate.

f_crate_o.name: open crate
f_crate_o.description: An open wooden storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has been pried off and is leaned adjacent to it, and with a fresh set of nails, could be sealed back shut.

f_cardboard_box.name: large cardboard box
f_cardboard_box.description: A large box made of brown corrugated paper.  Could contain a number of things.

f_cardboard_box_large_reinforced.name: reinforced large cardboard box
f_cardboard_box_large_reinforced.description: A large box made of brown corrugated paper that was doubled up for extra strength.  Could contain a number of things.

f_dresser.name: dresser
f_dresser.description: A simple wooden cabinet with a column of short drawers.  While intended for storing clothes, there's nothing stopping you from storing whatever fits.

f_glass_cabinet.name: glass front cabinet
f_glass_cabinet.description: A tall metal cabinet with a sheet of glass across the front for viewing the contents.  Often used for displaying rare, visually pleasing, or otherwise valuable goods, it's odd that it doesn't have a lock.

f_gunsafe_o.name: open gun safe
f_gunsafe_o.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  This one is wide open.

f_gunsafe_c.name: closed gun safe
f_gunsafe_c.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  This one is closed, but not locked.

f_gunsafe_ml.name: locked gun safe
f_gunsafe_ml.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  If you had something to pick its lock with, you could probably open it.
f_gunsafe_ml.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock on the gun safe door opens.

f_gunsafe_mj.name: jammed gun safe
f_gunsafe_mj.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and a rotary combination lock, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  Unfortunately, the lock is completely broken, and short of some pretty serious machinery, you have no possible way of opening it.

f_gun_safe_el.name: electronic gun safe
f_gun_safe_el.description: A large, heavy container with thick metal walls and an electronic locking system, designed to securely store firearms, weapon mods, and ammunition.  If you had some way of hacking into it, you could probably crack it open.

f_locker.name: locker
f_locker.description: A tall sheet metal cabinet, useful for storing just about anything that'll fit.

f_mailbox.name: mailbox
f_mailbox.description: A small metal box on top of a wooden post, designed to receive mail deliveries.  Although considering the circumstances, it will likely never see proper use again.

f_clothing_rail.name: clothing rail
f_clothing_rail.description: A metal frame on a set of wheels used for hanging large amounts of clothes.  Usually used in theater or retail environments, it's easy to use and quick to access.

f_rack.name: display rack
f_rack.description: A sheet metal shelving unit, with the storage surfaces angled in such a way as to show off the items stored.

f_rack_l.name: locked display rack
f_rack_l.description: A sheet metal shelving unit, with the storage surfaces angled in such a way as to show off the items stored.  Metal fasteners with a lock hold the items securely to the rack.
f_rack_l.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock opens.

f_rack_wood.name: wooden rack
f_rack_wood.description: A wooden shelving unit with angled storage surfaces designed to show off whatever is stored on it.

f_rack_primitive.name: simple wooden rack
f_rack_primitive.description: Wooden planks joined together and tied with cords to form a set of shelves.

f_rack_coat.name: coat rack
f_rack_coat.description: A tall wooden pole with a set of hooks used to store outdoor jackets and hats to allow easy access.

f_recycle_bin.name: recycle bin
f_recycle_bin.description: A large plastic bin painted green with a 'recycle' symbol emblazoned on it.  While intended to store discarded things to be processed back into a factory, the drastic change in priorities as of late means that these may hold valuable materials.

f_safe_c.name: safe
f_safe_c.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with a rotary combination lock.  This one isn't actually locked, just closed.

f_safe_l.name: safe
f_safe_l.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with a rotary combination lock.  With something to listen really closely and a hell of a lot of time, you might be able to crack it.

f_safe_o.name: open safe
f_safe_o.description: A small, heavy, and near-unbreachable metal box with a rotary combination lock, albeit significantly less secure with the door open.

f_trashcan.name: trash can
f_trashcan.description: A plastic bin for storing discarded waste as to be disposed of later.  Although, considering the circumstances, it might be worth seeing what's inside.

f_metal_trashcan.name: metal trash can
f_metal_trashcan.description: A crude metal bin typically used to dispose of waste.

f_wardrobe.name: wardrobe
f_wardrobe.description: A very large wooden cabinet for storing clothes, effectively an upright closet.  Could technically be used to store anything else that would fit, though.

f_torah_ark.name: Torah Ark
f_torah_ark.description: An ornately-carved cabinet designed to hold a Torah scroll.  This one is decorated with a tree motif, referencing Proverbs 3:18.

f_filing_cabinet.name: filing cabinet
f_filing_cabinet.description: A rack of metal drawers designed to hold various files and paperwork.  Paperwork that has more than likely lost all relevance and value by now.

f_utility_shelf.name: utility shelf
f_utility_shelf.description: A simple heavy-duty plastic and metal shelving unit, intended to store tools and materials for easy access to workers.

f_warehouse_shelf.name: warehouse shelf
f_warehouse_shelf.description: A huge, sturdy steel shelf for storing pallets of crates in warehouses.

f_wood_keg.name: wooden keg
f_wood_keg.description: A large standing wooden barrel, completely watertight.  Good for storing liquids of all kinds.

f_displaycase.name: display case
f_displaycase.description: A secure wooden case at about waist-height, with glass paneling on top.  Useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off.  Not actually as secure as it looks, as the display windows are easily broken.
f_displaycase.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock and the display case opens.

f_displaycase_o.name: open display case
f_displaycase_o.description: A secure wooden case at about waist-height, with glass paneling on top.  Useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off.  Not actually as secure as it looks, as the display windows are easily broken.  This one has had its lock picked and is open.

f_displaycase_b.name: broken display case
f_displaycase_b.description: A secure wooden case at about waist-height, with glass paneling on top.  Would be useful for storing valuable things while still showing them off, if the glass hadn't been shattered.  Careful not to cut yourself when looting.

f_board_map.name: map board
f_board_map.description: A secure metal board with a locked glass panel used to display a map.

f_board_map_b.name: broken map board
f_board_map_b.description: A metal board with a smashed glass panel used to display a map.

f_fireman_cabinet.name: fireman's cabinet
f_fireman_cabinet.description: A metallic cabinet painted to stand out, visibly holding tools behind a thin panel of tempered glass.
f_fireman_cabinet.lockpick_message: With a satisfying click, the lock on the cabinet opens.

f_fireman_cabinet_o.name: unlocked fireman's cabinet
f_fireman_cabinet_o.description: A metallic cabinet painted to stand out.  Its glass panel door was left unlocked and slightly ajar.

f_fireman_cabinet_b.name: open fireman's cabinet
f_fireman_cabinet_b.description: A metallic cabinet painted to stand out.  Its protective glass panel lies broken from some past emergency or looting attempt.

f_standing_tank.name: standing tank
f_standing_tank.description: A huge metal tank that can be used to safely store large amounts of liquid.

f_storage_tank.name: bulk storage tank
f_storage_tank.description: A 2 meters high tank that can store up to 1500 liters of liquid.  That's a lot.

f_gas_tank_smashed.name: broken fuel tank
f_gas_tank_smashed.description: A broken tank which was filled with gasoline.

f_diesel_tank_smashed.name: broken fuel tank
f_diesel_tank_smashed.description: A broken tank which was filled with diesel.

f_dumpster.name: dumpster
f_dumpster.description: A large metal dumpster that will likely not be getting picked up by the city's waste management any time soon.  Despite the unpleasant nature of climbing inside, it could make for a viable hiding spot.  Also high enough to help you climb buildings.

f_butter_churn.name: butter churn
f_butter_churn.description: A metal tube with a built-in mixer for making butter.  Rather than needing electricity, it is pedal-driven, allowing use without power.

f_metal_crate_r.name: riveted metal crate
f_metal_crate_r.description: This huge box is made of a dull metal, riveted together.  There is no obvious opening mechanism, and the rivets don't match any of your tools.  The only way in would be to smash it.

f_metal_crate_c.name: sealed metal crate
f_metal_crate_c.description: A huge, tightly sealed storage crate made from welded and riveted sheet metal.  The sealing mechanism is too tight to open bare-handed and would need some kind of prying instrument to release.

prying.message: You wrench open the metal crate.

prying_data.failure: The lid is sealed more tightly than you thought.

f_metal_crate_o.name: open metal crate
f_metal_crate_o.description: This large metal crate's lid is unsealed, and hinges open easily to reveal a number of storage shelves inside.  Once open, the side panels also swing wider for easy access.

f_chest.description: A sealed wooden storage container.  Lacking any labels, it could hold just about anything inside.  It has a simple metal latch.
f_chest.name: wooden chest

f_foot_locker.name: steel foot locker
f_foot_locker.description: A steel storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.

f_foot_locker_aluminum.name: aluminum foot locker
f_foot_locker_aluminum.description: An aluminum storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.

f_432gal_drum_rubber.name: big collapsible drum
f_432gal_drum_rubber.description: A black collapsible drum with a valve and D-Rings.  Yellow text on its top clearly says "FLAMMABLE".

f_pallet_belted.name: packed pallet
f_pallet_belted.description: A wooden pallet loaded with cargo, wrapped with a watertight cover, and belted to secure the contents.

f_pallet_belted_open.name: damaged pallet
f_pallet_belted_open.description: A wooden pallet, containing cargo and possessing a torn cover.  You can reach the contents, but it's awfully hard due to the belts still being in place.

f_exodii_kiln.name: Exodii kiln
f_exodii_kiln.description: An imposing kiln produced by the Exodii, used to produce their ceramic armor.

f_counter.name: counter
f_counter.description: A plain wooden countertop, either free-standing or affixed to a wall.  Makes a decent surface for storage or crafting.

f_cupboard.name: cupboard
f_cupboard.description: Store your cups.  Or other things, if you're feeling wild.

f_counter_gate_c.name: closed counter gate
f_counter_gate_c.description: A commercial-quality swinging door made of wood that allows passage behind counters.  It's currently closed.

f_counter_gate_o.name: open counter gate
f_counter_gate_o.description: A commercial-quality swinging door made of wood that allows passage behind counters.  It's open, allowing passage.

f_desk.name: desk
f_desk.description: A wooden desk with drawers.  You could decorate it with trinkets, eat a meal off it, use it as a workbench, read a book, write in a journal, put a laptop on it, put your feet up, rest your head for a nap if you're sitting down… who knew desks were so useful?

f_workbench.name: workbench
f_workbench.description: A sturdy workbench built out of metal.  It is perfect for crafting large and heavy things.

f_leather_tarp.name: leather tarp
f_leather_tarp.description: A large sheet of leather lying on the ground.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering as it does not soak up blood.

f_plastic_groundsheet.name: plastic groundsheet
f_plastic_groundsheet.description: A large sheet of thick plastic lying on the ground.  It could be a useful surface for butchering, perhaps.

f_fiber_mat.name: fiber mat
f_fiber_mat.description: A large mat woven from fibrous material.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering.  Too thin to be used as a comfortable sleeping mat.

f_tourist_table.name: folding table
f_tourist_table.description: A small metal folding table, ideal for off-road trips.  Can be used as a workbench in a pinch.

f_table.name: table
f_table.description: A standard wooden table.  You could sit down at it to eat like a civilized person.

f_table_fancy.name: fancy table
f_table_fancy.description: A fancy table for a fancy person.  Functions as both a table and status symbol.

f_coffee_table.name: coffee table
f_coffee_table.description: A low table usually found in living rooms, it makes an ideal surface for playing games, showing off some tasteful books, or presumably for putting coffee cups on.  No one cares if you use a coaster anymore.

f_metal_table.name: metal table
f_metal_table.description: A serviceable but simple table made of scrap metal.

f_tatami.name: tatami mat
f_tatami.description: A type of mat used as a flooring material in traditional Japanese-style rooms.

f_pillow_fort.name: pillow fort
f_pillow_fort.description: A comfy place to hide from the world.  Not very defensible, though.

f_cardboard_fort.name: cardboard fort
f_cardboard_fort.description: A fort built by tipping a cardboard box on its side, lining it with blankets, and partly weather-sealing it with a plastic sheet.

f_cardboard_wall.name: cardboard wall
f_cardboard_wall.description: A pile of cardboard boxes that have been filled with rags and junk and stacked together like bricks to form a wall.

f_cardboard_floor.name: cardboard floor
f_cardboard_floor.description: A flat floor made of sheets of cardboard duct-taped together, covering a plastic sheet on the ground.

f_cardboard_roof.name: cardboard roof
f_cardboard_roof.description: A sloped roof made of cardboard boxes, stuffed with scrap cardboard and paper and layered atop each other.  Sheets of plastic are carefully arranged on top to shed water.  It looks like it could last a season or two at least before crumbling.

f_cardboard_door_o.name: cardboard door
f_cardboard_door_o.description: A pile of cardboard boxes that have been filled with rags and junk and stacked together like bricks to form a wall.  The largest box has been cut open and folded to form a makeshift door, which is open.

f_cardboard_door.name: cardboard door
f_cardboard_door.description: A pile of cardboard boxes that have been filled with rags and junk and stacked together like bricks to form a wall.  The largest box has been cut open and folded to form a makeshift door, which is closed.

f_beaded_door.name: beaded curtain
f_beaded_door.description: A curtain of wooden beads, thick enough that you can't see through them.  They could be pulled aside effortlessly.

f_beaded_door_o.name: open beaded curtain
f_beaded_door_o.description: A curtain of wooden beads that has been pulled aside.

f_canvas_floor.name: canvas floor
f_canvas_floor.description: Flooring made out of stretched, waterproof cloth.  Helps keep dirt out of the tent.

f_canvas_wall.name: canvas wall
f_canvas_wall.description: A tent wall made of stretched, waterproof cloth.

f_large_canvas_wall.name: canvas wall
f_large_canvas_wall.description: A tent wall made of stretched, heavy-duty, waterproof cloth.

f_large_skin_wall.name: large skin wall
f_large_skin_wall.description: A large tent wall made out of stretched animal skin.  It'll keep the rain out, but anything trying to get in could rip through it fairly easily.

f_large_skin_groundsheet.name: large skin groundsheet
f_large_skin_groundsheet.description: A large animal-skin groundsheet to keep your feet dry inside the shelter.

f_skin_center_groundsheet.name: large skin groundsheet
f_skin_center_groundsheet.description: A large animal-skin groundsheet to keep your feet dry inside the shelter.

f_large_skin_door.name: large animalskin flap
f_large_skin_door.description: A large animal-skin flap that can be pulled aside.

f_large_skin_door_o.name: open animalskin flap
f_large_skin_door_o.description: A large animal-skin flap that has been pulled aside.

f_canvas_door.name: canvas flap
f_canvas_door.description: A canvas flap door that can be pulled aside.

f_canvas_door_o.name: open canvas flap
f_canvas_door_o.description: A canvas flap door that has been pulled aside.

f_large_canvas_door.name: canvas flap
f_large_canvas_door.description: A heavy canvas flap door that can be pulled aside.

f_large_canvas_door_o.name: open canvas flap
f_large_canvas_door_o.description: A heavy canvas flap door that has been pulled aside.

f_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_groundsheet.description: A plastic groundsheet to keep your feet dry inside the tent.

f_large_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_large_groundsheet.description: A large plastic groundsheet to keep your feet dry inside the tent.

f_center_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_center_groundsheet.description: A plastic groundsheet to keep your feet dry inside the tent.

f_fema_groundsheet.name: groundsheet
f_fema_groundsheet.description: A government-issue plastic groundsheet to keep your feet dry, it was clearly made by the lowest bidder.

f_skin_wall.name: animalskin wall
f_skin_wall.description: A tent wall made out of stretched animal skin.  It'll keep the rain out, but anything trying to get in could rip through it fairly easily.

f_skin_door.name: animalskin flap
f_skin_door.description: An animal-skin flap that can be pulled aside.

f_skin_door_o.name: open animalskin flap
f_skin_door_o.description: An animal-skin flap that has been pulled aside.

f_skin_groundsheet.name: animalskin floor
f_skin_groundsheet.description: An animal-skin groundsheet to keep your feet dry inside the shelter.

f_rubble.name: pile of rubble
f_rubble.description: A pile of various metals, bricks, and other building materials.  You could clear it with a shovel.

f_rubble_rock.name: pile of rocky rubble
f_rubble_rock.description: A loose pile of rocks.  Useless?

f_rubble_volc.name: pile of rocky rubble
f_rubble_volc.description: A loose pile of rocks.  This one has bright chalky bits in it.

f_rubble_landfill.name: pile of trashy rubble
f_rubble_landfill.description: A pile of trash topped with dirt and grass.  It smells gross, but one man's trash…

f_wreckage.name: metal wreckage
f_wreckage.description: A pile of various bent and twisted metals.  Some of it looks pretty rusty, you wouldn't want to cut yourself on this.

f_plane_wreckage.name: metal wreckage from a plane
f_plane_wreckage.description: A pile of various bent and twisted metals.  Some of it looks pretty rusty, you wouldn't want to cut yourself on this.

f_reactor_meltdown.name: radioactive slag
f_reactor_meltdown.description: A pile of melted slag from a destroyed nuclear reactor.  What are you doing looking at it?  Get the hell out of here, you nutcase!

f_ash.name: pile of ash
f_ash.description: A pile of ash, from wood or possibly corpses.

f_boulder_small.name: small boulder
f_boulder_small.description: A big rock.  Should be easy to roll around, but too heavy to carry with you.  It can be used as a primitive anvil, or broken into a bunch of smaller rocks.

f_boulder_medium.name: medium boulder
f_boulder_medium.description: A pretty big boulder, but still small enough to see and climb over.  It would be a struggle to move it.  It can be used as a primitive anvil, or broken into a bunch of smaller rocks.

f_boulder_large.name: large boulder
f_boulder_large.description: A boulder that's taller than you.  Now how are you going to move this?

f_boulder_small_volc.name: small volcanic boulder
f_boulder_small_volc.description: A big rock.  Should be easy to roll around, but too heavy to carry with you.  This one has efflorescent streaks and might contain volcanic elements.

f_boulder_medium_volc.name: medium boulder
f_boulder_medium_volc.description: A pretty big boulder, but still small enough to see and climb over.  This one has efflorescent streaks and might contain volcanic elements.

f_boulder_large_volc.name: large boulder
f_boulder_large_volc.description: A boulder that's taller than you.  Now how are you going to move this?  This one has efflorescent streaks and might contain volcanic elements.

f_street_light.name: street light
f_street_light.description: A raised light source which used to illuminate streets and their surrounding area, but it's useless without electricity.

f_traffic_light.name: traffic light
f_traffic_light.description: A signaling device positioned at road intersections and pedestrian crossings to control the flow of traffic, but it's useless without electricity.

f_bike_rack.name: bike rack
f_bike_rack.description: A loop of metal in the shape of an upside down U used to securely park bikes.

f_flagpole.name: flagpole
f_flagpole.description: A 6-meter tall metal flagpole.  You could hoist up a flag here.

f_wooden_flagpole.name: flagpole
f_wooden_flagpole.description: A 5-meter tall wooden flagpole.  You could hoist up a flag here.

f_utility_pole.name: utility pole
f_utility_pole.description: A long wooden post which used to support overhead power lines and other public utilities, but it doesn't work anymore.

f_scrap_bridge.name: scrap metal bridge
f_scrap_bridge.description: A simple bridge made of riveted sheet metal.

f_room_divider.name: room divider
f_room_divider.description: A tall piece of furniture used to divide rooms into separate areas.

f_dirtmound_shallow.description: An area of heaped dirt, not easily traversable.

f_dirtmound_pile.description: An area of dirt heaped up to your shoulders, not easily traversable.

f_dirtmound_tall.description: An area of dirt heaped well above your head, difficult to climb over.

f_console_broken.description: A standalone computer terminal.  It doesn't seem to be working.  It's the broken screen and shattered circuit boards telling you that.

f_console.name: computer console
f_console.description: A standalone computer terminal, the screen glowing with dim artificial light.  If examined closely, you can read what's on the screen and perform any allowed functions.  It might even be possible to hack it, given the skills.

f_console_broken_table.name: broken console
f_console_broken_table.description: A standalone computer terminal.  It doesn't seem to be working.  It's the broken screen and shattered circuit boards telling you that.

f_forge.name: forge
f_forge.description: A metalworking station typically used in combination with an anvil.

f_forge_artisan_0.name: Cody's forge
f_forge_artisan_0.description: A metalworking station typically used in combination with an anvil.  You can see pipes running into the walls.

f_forge_artisan_1.name: Cody's forge
f_forge_artisan_1.description: A metalworking station typically used in combination with an anvil.  You can see pipes running into the walls.

f_anvil.name: anvil
f_anvil.description: A heavy block of oddly-shaped metal with a pritchel hole and hardy hole.  It's used for metalworking.

f_camp_anvil.name: anvil (camp)
f_camp_anvil.description: A heavy block of oddly-shaped metal with a pritchel hole and hardy hole.  It's used for metalworking.

f_anvil_bronze.name: bronze anvil
f_anvil_bronze.description: A heavy block of oddly-shaped bronze with a pritchel hole and hardy hole.  It's used for metalworking.

f_anvil_heavy.name: heavy anvil
f_anvil_heavy.description: An enormously heavy block of oddly-shaped metal with all the accoutrements a blacksmith could ask for.  It's used for heavy-duty metalworking.

f_anvil_ingot.name: makeshift anvil
f_anvil_ingot.description: A steel ingot mounted into a heavy log to make a suitable anvil.  Smaller steel pieces serve as shaping surfaces.

f_anvil_scavenged.name: scavenger's anvil
f_anvil_scavenged.description: An old machinery part, cut and smoothed to make a serviceable anvil, and mounted to a heavy log stand.

f_still.name: still
f_still.description: An essential component for brewing and chemistry that allows for refining liquid mixtures.

f_screw_press.name: screw press
f_screw_press.description: A large screw press for manually pressing oil out of fruit or seed paste.  The paste is placed in wetted bags and pressed down by the force of the screw mechanism.

f_kiln_empty.name: charcoal kiln
f_kiln_empty.description: A primitive rock kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in the absence of oxygen.  It isn't especially efficient compared to a modern metal variant.

f_kiln_full.name: filled charcoal kiln
f_kiln_full.description: A primitive rock kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in the absence of oxygen.  It isn't especially efficient compared to a modern metal variant.

f_kiln_portable_empty.name: metal charcoal kiln
f_kiln_portable_empty.description: A metal kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in the absence of oxygen.  Much more efficient than its archaic rock counterpart.

f_kiln_portable_full.name: filled metal charcoal kiln
f_kiln_portable_full.description: A metal kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in the absence of oxygen.  Much more efficient than its archaic rock counterpart.

f_kiln_metal_empty.name: metal charcoal kiln
f_kiln_metal_empty.description: A metal kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in the absence of oxygen.  Much more efficient than its archaic rock counterpart.

f_kiln_metal_full.name: filled metal charcoal kiln
f_kiln_metal_full.description: A metal kiln designed to burn wood and organic material into charcoal in the absence of oxygen.  Much more efficient than its archaic rock counterpart.

f_arcfurnace_empty.name: arc furnace
f_arcfurnace_empty.description: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.

f_arcfurnace_full.name: filled arc furnace
f_arcfurnace_full.description: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.

f_smoking_rack.name: smoking rack
f_smoking_rack.description: A wooden rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  Works as a charcoal smoker in crafting recipes.

f_spinwheel.name: spinning wheel
f_spinwheel.description: A large wooden device with a mechanical wheel used to combine fibers together into a stronger material.

f_spinwheel_cordage.name: spinning wheel
f_spinwheel_cordage.description: A large wooden device with a mechanical wheel used to combine fibers together into a stronger material.

f_spinwheel_leather.name: spinning wheel
f_spinwheel_leather.description: A large wooden device with a mechanical wheel used to combine fibers together into a stronger material.

f_scutch_breaker.name: stationary scutcher
f_scutch_breaker.description: A bulky, simple-hinged wooden device to break up the hard parts of fiber plants, with nail combs on the back for separating them out.

f_smoking_rack_active.name: active smoking rack
f_smoking_rack_active.description: A wooden rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  It is lit and smoking.

f_metal_smoking_rack.name: metal smoking rack
f_metal_smoking_rack.description: A metal rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  Works as a charcoal smoker in crafting recipes.

f_metal_smoking_rack_active.name: active metal smoking rack
f_metal_smoking_rack_active.description: A metal rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.

f_forge_rock.name: rock forge
f_forge_rock.description: A metalworking station made of rock, typically used in combination with an anvil.  Works as a charcoal forge in crafting recipes.

f_clay_kiln.name: clay kiln
f_clay_kiln.description: A kiln designed to bake clay pottery and bricks.

f_ladder.name: wooden stepladder
f_ladder.description: A short, foldable wooden ladder.  Can help you climb to a rooftop, or maybe slow something down.

f_aluminum_stepladder.name: aluminum stepladder
f_aluminum_stepladder.description: A short, foldable aluminum ladder.  Can help you climb to a rooftop, or maybe slow something down.

f_beverly_shear.name: Beverly shear
f_beverly_shear.description: A massive bench-mounted device with a short guillotine blade mounted to a long lever.  Designed for making straight or curved cuts through sheet metal up to 3 millimeters thick.

f_drill_press.name: drill press
f_drill_press.description: A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_power_hammer.name: power hammer
f_power_hammer.description: A self-contained pneumatic power hammer using compressed air from an integrated compressor to strike repeatedly with great force.  Used for efficiently shaping and working metal.

f_steel_kiln.name: tempering kiln
f_steel_kiln.description: A very long electric kiln made for heat treating metal.  Unlike a forge, it can't get extremely hot, but its temperature is completely programmable.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

f_firefly_terrarium.name: firefly terrarium
f_firefly_terrarium.description: While many survivors would have focused on trying to bring back electric lights, whoever lives here has apparently decided to make use of the changes wrought by the Cataclysm to provide light.  This vivarium contains soil, strange plants you don't recognize immediately, and most strikingly, a giant mutant firefly.

f_tablesaw.name: table saw
f_tablesaw.description: A rotating sawblade set into a large, flat table, for making straight measured cuts.  It's a key tool in any carpenter's arsenal.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_mitresaw.name: mitre saw
f_mitresaw.description: A circular sawblade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_bandsaw.name: band saw
f_bandsaw.description: A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_router.name: router table
f_router.description: This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves and stuff.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_planer.name: planer
f_planer.description: A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width, particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_jointer.name: jointer
f_jointer.description: A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it very smooth and nice indeed.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_catalytic_cracking_reactor.name: disconnected catalytic cracking reactor
f_catalytic_cracking_reactor.description: A makeshift extraction system, or as makeshift as you can consider something that was purpose-built in a laboratory by a group of experts.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_hydraulic_press.name: hydraulic press
f_hydraulic_press.description: If you really want to squash something a lot, this would be exactly the right industrial tool for you.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_heavy_lathe.name: lathe
f_heavy_lathe.description: An industrial-grade lathe, for turning chunks of metal and other hard things into round chunks of metal and other hard things.  It's really heavy but you could take this down and use it for your own purposes if you wanted.

f_air_compressor.name: air compressor
f_air_compressor.description: This durable tank is topped with a motor that will cram as much air into the tank as possible.  You can take this down and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

f_manual_tire_changer.name: manual tire changer
f_manual_tire_changer.description: This floor-mounted machine contains all the levers, clamps and mounts required to remove or fit a tire, plus an integrated foot pump to inflate it.

f_fvat_empty.name: fermenting vat
f_fvat_empty.description: A sealable 50-liter vat for fermenting vinegar and various alcoholic brews.

f_fvat_full.name: filled fermenting vat
f_fvat_full.description: A sealable 50-liter vat for fermenting vinegar and various alcoholic brews.

f_fvat_wood_empty.name: wooden fermenting vat
f_fvat_wood_empty.description: A sealable 50-liter wooden vat for fermenting vinegar and various alcoholic brews.

f_fvat_wood_full.name: filled wooden fermenting vat
f_fvat_wood_full.description: A sealable 50-liter wooden vat for fermenting vinegar and various alcoholic brews.

f_butcher_rack.name: butchering rack
f_butcher_rack.description: A wooden butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.

f_metal_butcher_rack.name: metal butchering rack
f_metal_butcher_rack.description: A metal butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.  It can be deconstructed and folded for easy transportation.

f_hanging_meathook.name: hanging meathook
f_hanging_meathook.description: A hefty hook suspended from a chain for stringing up corpses.

f_wind_mill.name: wind mill
f_wind_mill.description: A small wind-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.

f_wind_mill_active.name: active wind mill
f_wind_mill_active.description: A small wind-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Its brake has been removed and it is turning.

f_water_mill.name: water mill
f_water_mill.description: A small water-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.

f_water_mill_active.name: active water mill
f_water_mill_active.description: A small water-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Its brake has been removed and it is turning.

f_aut_gas_console.name: automated gas console
f_aut_gas_console.description: An automated gas flow control console.

f_aut_gas_console_o.name: broken automated gas console
f_aut_gas_console_o.description: An automated gas flow control console.  It's broken.  This is not a good thing.

f_vending_reinforced.name: reinforced vending machine
f_vending_reinforced.description: A bit tougher to crack open than a regular vending machine.  That just makes it all the sweeter of a target, doesn't it?

f_vending_reinforced_networked.name: reinforced vending machine
f_vending_reinforced_networked.description: A bit tougher to crack open than a regular vending machine.  That just makes it all the sweeter of a target, doesn't it?

f_vending_reinforced_off.name: reinforced vending machine (off)
f_vending_reinforced_off.description: A bit tougher to crack open than a regular vending machine.  Out of order, for lack of power.  That just makes it all the sweeter of a target, doesn't it?

f_vending_c.name: vending machine
f_vending_c.description: An upright metal cabinet with a see-through door.  The goods inside can be yours if you have money on a cash card.

f_vending_c_networked.name: vending machine
f_vending_c_networked.description: An upright metal cabinet with a see-through door.  The goods inside can be yours if you have money on a cash card.

f_vending_c_off.name: vending machine (off)
f_vending_c_off.description: An upright metal cabinet with a see-through door.  Out of order, for lack of power.

f_vending_o.name: broken vending machine
f_vending_o.description: An upright metal cabinet with a see-through door.  It's smashed open, so you can take whatever you want for free.

f_rope_up.name: grappling hook
f_rope_up.description: A dangling piece of rope, hooked securely to something above you.  You could climb up or take it down.

f_vine_up.name: vine leading up
f_vine_up.description: A thick vine is rigidly anchored to something above you.  It looks quite alive.  You could climb up or tear it down.

f_web_up.name: web leading up
f_web_up.description: A thick, dangling strand of slightly sticky web, the other end is tied securely to something above you.  You could use it to climb up.

f_hoist_rope.name: rope hoist
f_hoist_rope.description: A loop of rope hangs here, using a sturdy horizontal support as a basic pulley.  While crude, it gives you some mechanical advantage for lifting things.

f_hoist_pulley.name: rope and tackle hoist
f_hoist_pulley.description: A loop of rope hangs here, looped through a quality tackle to give a significant mechanical advantage while lifting heavy objects.

f_hoist_chain.name: chain hoist
f_hoist_chain.description: A sturdy chain and heavy tackle hang well-supported from the ceiling here, ready to lift most heavy items you could think of using mechanical advantage.

f_oil_press_industrial.name: industrial oil press
f_oil_press_industrial.description: A heavy-duty press used to create vegetable oil from nuts or seeds.  You could take this down and use it for your own purposes if you wanted.

f_glowingbulb.name: illuminating plant bulb
f_glowingbulb.description: A small plant grows among the roots here, its green, onion-like bulb illuminating the area around it.

f_brambles.name: brambles
f_brambles.description: A wall of tangled roots blocks the path here, you'd have destroy it to get past.

f_midden.name: composting midden
f_midden.description: A hole has been dug into the roots here, and a pretty unpleasant smell emits from it.

f_LIXA_unfold_barrier.name: wall of flat space
f_LIXA_unfold_barrier.description: From a distance, this looks like where the chamber ends; a flat wall, with a very detailed painting of a tunnel behind it.  But as you get closer, you can see how it ripples, like lazy water, and notice angles of the space beyond that a flat image could never give.

f_LIXA_machinery_electronic.name: unfolded machinery
f_LIXA_machinery_electronic.description: This inscrutable device is filled with wires, boards, and connections.  You can see every one of them, and it gives you a headache.

f_LIXA_electrical_conduit.name: photonic conduit
f_LIXA_electrical_conduit.description: You can see through the metal casing of this tube, into the blazing light coursing through it.

f_lixa_whiteboard.name: whiteboard
f_lixa_whiteboard.description: A wide space of whiteboard, for writing on with washable markers.  No one has washed it in a long time, though; it is covered in dense scrawls of equations and waveform diagrams.

f_nl_exodii_lamp.name: strange utility light
f_nl_exodii_lamp.description: Parts of this utility light have a curved appearance, as though the metal were grown in a lab.  The round bulb emits an eerie greenish glow.

f_nl_pipe_plant.name: pipe plant
f_nl_pipe_plant.description: This looks like a squat collection of reeds.  Upon closer inspection, they are almost identical in shape to plumbing pipes, just made of a wood-like material.

f_nl_climbing_vine.name: climbing vines
f_nl_climbing_vine.description: This floor-to-ceiling collection of vines is twisted and gnarled, like fraying, loose wires.  Its surface has a plastic sheen.

f_nl_water_cooler.name: bulbous water dispenser
f_nl_water_cooler.description: This device almost looks like an earthly water cooler, but the base is made of scrap metal, and the tank is a bulbous, black glass globe that obfuscates its contents.  It has no tap; instead, the base has a small compartment with a plastic flap, resembling that of a vending machine.  Examine it to dispense drinks, if it has any.

effect.title: You see a seven-segment LED display and a circular button.  The display reads: <u_val:nl_safehouse_water_stock>

f_nl_boiler.name: clouded cylinder
f_nl_boiler.description: A massive cylindrical device.  Perhaps the exterior was once translucent, but it's now deeply clouded and yellowed, with filth grasping where the plastic-like material meets the floor and ceiling.  Behind the plastic is some sort of large, bulbous object, too obscured to make heads or tails of.  It's bolted down with extremely thick and heavy-looking hardware.

f_nl_safehouse_boiler.name: otherworldly boiler
f_nl_safehouse_boiler.description: A huge, pot-bellied device that resembles something between a coal-burning stove and a boiler, with a wide, hinged cage covering the combustion chamber.  Three unmarked gauges sit like alien eyes upon its face.  A side-mounted crank is its only visible control.  In defiance of its apparent function, it has no exhaust vent; in its place is a hose twisted on itself several times, coiled in copper, and terminating in a bulbous back-mounted battery pack.

f_nl_autodoc.name: twitchy medical robot
f_nl_autodoc.description: A lanky set of robotic limbs armed with surgical devices and construction tools.  The arms protrude from a barrel-like base, mounted upon small casters.  Even when idle, it moves like an insect grooming its antennae.  The scalpel is stropped against another arm.  The over-articulated grasper picks at the other tools.  The circular saw silently rotates, as if it were itself scanning the surroundings.  Embedded in the side of the device is a bulbous computer terminal, displaying several options, from standard medical services to advanced bionic surgery.

f_nl_autodoc_couch.name: operation table
f_nl_autodoc_couch.description: A hard metal table on wheels, with several auxiliary medical devices of unknown origin.  Several screens dangle from the edge, black in their idle state, but with several burned-in lines, as if it had seen continuous service for many years.

f_bullettrailer_table_top.name: table
f_bullettrailer_table_top.description: A small trailer table, designed to convert into a bed when not in use.

f_bullettrailer_table_middle.name: table
f_bullettrailer_table_middle.description: A small trailer table, designed to convert into a bed when not in use.

f_bullettrailer_table_bottom.name: table
f_bullettrailer_table_bottom.description: A small trailer table, designed to convert into a bed when not in use.

f_bullettrailer_cabinet.name: trailer cabinets
f_bullettrailer_cabinet.description: Cramped trailer cabinets, with some inbuilt appliances taking up even more of the limited space.

f_bullettrailer_sink.name: trailer sink
f_bullettrailer_sink.description: A tiny metal sink and connected cabinet.

f_bullettrailer_desk.name: mini desk
f_bullettrailer_desk.description: A small wooden desk with a little attached bookshelf.

f_bullettrailer_toilet.name: travel toilet
f_bullettrailer_toilet.description: A tiny plastic toilet for use in a travel trailer.  Unlike a normal toilet, it doesn't store water locally for you to siphon out.

f_bullettrailer_minisofa.name: trailer sofa
f_bullettrailer_minisofa.description: A folding trailer sofa with a durable, somewhat comfortable weave of coarse red fabric.

f_bullettrailer_bed_foot.name: trailer bed
f_bullettrailer_bed_foot.description: A small but comfy-looking double bed.

f_bullettrailer_bed_head.name: trailer bed
f_bullettrailer_bed_head.description: A small but comfy-looking double bed.

f_bullettrailer_sign_danabakery.name: plywood sign for 'Dana's Bakery'
f_bullettrailer_sign_danabakery.description: A spraypainted plywood sign reads 'Dana's Bakery' in red letters.

f_sunkenhelicopter_seat_rotating.name: waterlogged bucket seat
f_sunkenhelicopter_seat_rotating.description: A waterlogged soft upholstered car seat, contoured to hold one person.  It has started to degrade after some time spent underwater.  Absolutely unrecoverable.

f_string_dimension_distress_beacon_1.name: powered odd monitor
f_string_dimension_distress_beacon_1.description: A bulbous monitor.  It displays a garbled image and one glowing circle.

f_string_dimension_distress_beacon_2.name: powered odd monitor
f_string_dimension_distress_beacon_2.description: A bulbous monitor.  It displays a garbled image and two glowing circles.

f_string_dimension_distress_beacon_3.name: powered odd monitor
f_string_dimension_distress_beacon_3.description: A bulbous monitor.  It displays a topological map.  There's nothing new or interesting on it.

f_mutant_tree_adult.name: mutant tree
f_mutant_tree_adult.description: This bizarre tree spreads its twisted branches at odd angles toward the sky.  If you squint, it almost looks like a human figure with its arms raised to catch the sun.

f_mutant_tree_sapling.name: mutant sapling
f_mutant_tree_sapling.description: A twisted and gnarled little tree.  Its shape is at once alien and familiar.

f_mutant_tree_sprout.name: sprout
f_mutant_tree_sprout.description: A tiny little sprout that has just begun to grow.
